jobs.title: Sr. Prism Analytics Consultant - Workday Success Plans
jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

The Workday Success Plans Team are all about our customers and their post Go-Live journey - we create programs to help them drive business value from their Workday applications. The team is responsible for delivering a variety of programs and services to our customers ranging from feature demonstrations to full feature deployments.

At Workday, we help the world’s largest organizations adapt to what’s next by bringing finance, HR, and planning into a single enterprise cloud. We work hard, and we’re serious about what we do. But we like to have fun, too! We put people first, celebrate diversity, drive innovation, and do good in the communities where we live and work.

About The Role

Would you enjoy learning new things in a fast-paced environment? Do you have an appetite for variety and challenging business problems to solve? Are you a great communicator who can clearly articulate and demonstrate the value of Workday solutions to our customers? The Workday Success Plans team works directly with customers through targeted micro consulting engagements to help solve their business needs using the Workday application. Responsible for acting as a trusted Workday advisor, you will have the opportunity to assist customers with how-to questions, troubleshoot and guide customers through configuration, and provide feature demonstrations. As a Workday expert, customers will benefit from your knowledge as you share your experience, identify key considerations, and highlight standard methodologies.

Our team of professionals have a broad and deep understanding of Workday, and enjoy the reward of helping customers solve problems, learn about new features, and find greater value in their Workday investment. If you are passionate about the value technology can bring to an organization, love learning and want to work directly with some of the greatest companies on the planet, bring your energy and teamwork to the Workday Success Plans team!

Primary responsibilities of this role include delivering various services to Workday Success Plans customers. To be successful, this requires:

Conducting research to ensure understanding of customer questions and related Workday concepts.
Delivering small scope consulting in response to customer requests; providing configuration guidance, demonstrations, considerations, tips & tricks.
Troubleshooting product configuration to resolve or provide optimal product configuration to meet customer business requirements.
Clearly and effectively communicating responses and value to customers.
Creating and delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals (Accelerator Webinars).
Providing one-on-one consulting guidance to accelerate customer feature adoption (Feature Accelerator).
Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities (Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews).
Completing and maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) along with familiarity with Workday roadmap.
Keeping up to date with industry practices and the ability to engage with our customers on those topics.
Helping drive the creation of new programs to drive customer feature adoption.

In addition to delivering Workday Success Plans services, our Workday professionals will also deliver other Customer Enablement services, such as:

Office Hours to conduct appointment-based consulting engagements providing guidance and product expertise to customers
Perform configuration and business requirements reviews with a detailed deliverable calling out opportunities for optimization
Provide one-on-one customer configuration designs
Deployments including full deployment of Workday features

About You

Basic Qualifications:

3+ years of proven ability building and maintaining Prism Analytics
3+ years of proven ability building and maintaining Workday HCM/Financial Reporting & Analytics
5+ years of HCM Reporting, Analytics, and Data warehousing experience for enterprise software applications
3+ years of IT implementation experience
3+ years of software consulting experience

Additional Qualifications:

Workday Certification or ability to certify in Prism Analytics and at least one of the following: Workday HCM, Workday Financial, Workday Reporting
Ability to gain a thorough understanding of Workday concepts as new features are released
Ability to distill complex concepts into understandable presentations for our customers
Ability to multitask and work on multiple engagements and deliverables simultaneously
Strong critical thinking skills so as to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate/influence decision making
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience required. Advanced degree preferred

Workday Pay Transparency Statement (For EU Locations Only)

Listed below is the base salary range applicable to this position. Workday pay ranges (and the precise pay offered to the successful candidate) are based on a number of objective criteria such as relevant experience and skills, and educational qualifications, level of responsibility, demands of the role, work location and business need. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants awarded by Workday Inc. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

Primary Location Base Pay Range: €70,600 EUR - €106,000 EUR Netherlands

Additional Location Base Pay Range: €54,900 EUR - €82,300 EUR Spain

Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst – AI & Cloud Platforms
jobs.description:
Locatie:
Utrecht (hybride)
Startdatum:
november/december
Duur

Uren:
36 uur per week
Ervaring:
Senior
Dienstverband:
Detachering (ZZP niet mogelijk)

Salarisindicatie (o.b.v. 36 uur):

€ 5.300 – € 5.650 Bruto maandsalaris
€ 441 – € 471 Vakantietoeslag (8,33%)
€ 5.741 – € 6.121 Bruto per maand

(Uitbetaling van toeslagen kan maandelijks of jaarlijks, afhankelijk van jouw voorkeur)

Over de opdracht

Voor een grote financiële organisatie in Utrecht zoeken wij een Technical Business Analyst die de verbinding legt tussen businessbehoeften en technische oplossingen op het gebied van AI.

Binnen deze opdracht werk je aan de ontwikkeling van AI-platformen en toepassingen met autonome AI-agents ( Agentic AI ). Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar duidelijke requirements en zorgt dat onderwerpen zoals security, identity management, compliance en technische haalbaarheid vanaf het begin worden meegenomen.

Wat ga je doen

Analyseren en vertalen van businessbehoeften naar functionele en niet-functionele requirements.
Uitwerken van AI-toepassingen, gebruikersprocessen en meetbare acceptatiecriteria.
Afstemmen met business stakeholders, Product Owners, architecten, engineers en securityspecialisten.
In kaart brengen van integraties tussen AI-agents, bedrijfsapplicaties, API's en databronnen.
Vastleggen van eisen rondom identity & access management, autorisaties en gegevensbescherming.
Signaleren van technische afhankelijkheden, risico's en knelpunten.
Ondersteunen bij vraagstukken rondom cloudplatformen, containerisatie en Kubernetes.
Bewaken van de samenhang tussen requirements, ontwikkeling, testen en implementatie.

Wat breng je mee?

Hbo-werk- en denkniveau.
Aantoonbare ervaring als Business Analyst of Technical Business Analyst binnen complexe IT-omgevingen.
Ervaring met requirements engineering, procesmodellering en het opstellen van acceptatiecriteria.
Kennis van Generative AI, Agentic AI en AI-agents, waaronder orchestration en tool calling.
Begrip van Identity & Access Management (IAM), authenticatie, autorisatie, RBAC en SSO.
Kennis van cloudplatformen, API's, containerisatie en Kubernetes.
Affiniteit met informatiebeveiliging, privacy, compliance en risicomanagement.
Ervaring met Agile of hybride ontwikkelomgevingen.
Uitstekende beheersing van de Engelse taal.

Pré :
Ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening of een andere sterk gereguleerde sector.
Ervaring met AI-platformen en enterprise-integraties.
Kennis van security-by-design, logging, secrets management en niet-functionele eisen rondom schaalbaarheid en beschikbaarheid.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en weet complexe technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende stakeholders.
Je stelt kritische vragen, herkent risico's en onduidelijkheden en zorgt dat business en IT vanuit dezelfde uitgangspunten samenwerken. Je hoeft zelf geen architect of engineer te zijn, maar begrijpt de technische context voldoende om inhoudelijk mee te denken.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Een uitdagende opdracht binnen een grote financiële organisatie waar AI een belangrijke rol speelt in de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale dienstverlening.

Je werkt samen met specialisten op het gebied van AI, cloud, architectuur en security en krijgt de kans om bij te dragen aan innovatieve toepassingen binnen een complexe enterprise-omgeving.

Interesse?

Ben jij een Technical Business Analyst met affiniteit voor AI, cloudtechnologie en complexe IT-vraagstukken?

Solliciteer dan! We komen graag met je in contact!

jobs.title: IT-traineeship Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Wil je niet zomaar een IT-traineeship? En spreekt leren door te doen je aan? Als IT trainee Test Automation Engineer bij IVO Rechtspraak, de IT-dienstverlener van de Rechtspraak, werk je mee aan projecten van betekenis. Met de collega’s in je team bouw je software die de rechtspraak helpt beter te werken. Spannend? Geen zorgen, je kunt rekenen op je collega’s en je buddy. Interessant? Zeker, want je ontwikkelt je ook persoonlijk. En dat samen met de andere IT-trainees, dus ook nog leuk!

Wat ga je doen?

Het antwoord op die vraag is een inkoppertje. Want ons Traineeship (https://www.werkenbijderechtspraak.nl/ivo-rechtspraak/traineeship)draait maar om één ding: dat jij je talenten als professional maximaal ontwikkelt en inzet! We halen alles uit de kast, met een programma op maat van jou! In twee jaar tijd krijg je volop de kans om kennis en ervaring op te doen en je soft skills te vergroten.

Jij zorgt dat onze software doet wat-ie moet doen. Want bij IVO Rechtspraak willen we dat onze digitale diensten goed toegankelijk zijn en betrouwbaar werken. Daar moeten onze gebruikers op kunnen vertrouwen, of het nu gaat om een rechter, griffiemedewerker, advocaat, officier van justitie of burger. Als tester test je de web- en system2system-applicaties die toegang geven tot de digitale rechtspraak, en ben je het kwaliteitsgeweten van je DevOps-team. Werkt de software die jullie bouwen straks wel goed? Aan welke aspecten is misschien niet gedacht? En hoe controleer je dat? Dat zijn de vragen waar jij continu mee bezig bent.

Daarbij overleg je ook met gebruikers, want daar doen we het tenslotte allemaal voor. Hoe werken zij met de systemen? Parallel aan het bouwtraject maak je een testplan en testscripts, met als uitgangspunt dat je zoveel mogelijk geautomatiseerd test. Een sterke developersmindset is daarbij prettig. Je kijkt niet alleen naar de happy flow, dus als alles volgens plan verloopt, maar onderzoekt ook of de software overeind blijft in onverwachte situaties. Daarnaast maak je scripts om de performance te meten. Met jouw feedback help je je team applicaties op te leveren die hun werk doen, en daar ben je trots op!

Een bijzonder IT-traineeship omdat...

je leren en werken vanaf dag één combineert, onder persoonlijke begeleiding. je direct onderdeel bent van een DevOps-team en meewerkt aan applicaties voor de rechtspraak.
je samen met andere IT-trainees niet alleen opleidingen volgt, maar ook leuke dingen doet.
je onderdeel bent van een organisatie die inclusiviteit en diversiteit koestert.
je werk onmisbaar is voor een rechtvaardige samenleving.

Dit krijg je ervoor terug

Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij:

Contract: een jaarcontract voor 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
Salaris: Je zit in schaal 9 (trede 0) en hebt een salaris van € 3.579,02 bruto per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur Daarnaast heb je een Individueel Keuzebudget van € 590,54, waarmee je zelf je arbeidsvoorwaarden samenstelt. Koop bijvoorbeeld extra verlof, schaf een fiets aan of los je studieschuld fiscaal vriendelijk af.
Doorgroeimogelijkheden: je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen.
Werk-privébalans: je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek.
Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 26 vrije dagen op basis van een 36-urige werkweek.
Gratis OV: je krijgt van ons een OV-chipkaart voor je woon-werkverkeer.
Pensioen: je bouwt je pensioen op bij het ABP, een van de grootste pensioenfondsen van Nederland. Ook dat is dus goed geregeld.
Leuke activiteiten: een teamdag, borrelmiddagen, een after summer-feest … er gebeurt van alles. Of organiseer ook zelf iets met je collega’s, van padel tot yoga of een pubquiz.

Bekijk hier alle arbeidsvoorwaarden > (https://www.werkenvoornederland.nl/over-de-rijksoverheid/arbeidsvoorwaarden)

Wat jouw collega Hieu waardeert aan het traineeship

“Met mijn manager kijk ik welke cursussen het meest waardevol zijn voor mij en mijn team. Voor de rest leer ik on the job met tools te werken, ik pas mijn kennis meteen toe. Mijn buddy begeleidt me bij het werk en geeft me tips. Ook mijn soft skills ontwikkel ik, via leiderschaps- en communicatietrainingen. Daar heb ik veel aan!”

Hieu, IT-trainee test automation engineer

Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van Trainee test automation engineer Hieu? Je leest het in zijn blog
.

Wat we van jou verwachten

analytisch denken?
gestructureerd te werk gaan?
goed samenwerken?
zorgvuldig en helder communiceren?

maximaal 2 jaar werkervaring na je studie?
een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel in mondelinge als schriftelijke communicatie?
een brede leergierigheid en de wil om jezelf te ontwikkelen?

jobs.title: Data Scientist Fraud Monitoring
jobs.description:
At a glance

Are you a pioneering data scientist who likes to think outside-the-box?

Would you like to drive new data science solutions to tackle financial fraud?

Do you want to work with cutting-edge technologies to catch criminals?

Your job

As a data scientist, in the Grid Channel Security, you will work together with fraud experts, data scientists, machine learning engineers and data analysts to safeguard our customers from criminals. This includes threats such as phishing, account takeover, lost or stolen debit cards, e-commerce fraud, and more.

Your role will encompass analysing diverse data sources to get actionable insights. This analysis will include, but not limited to, understanding fraud trends across various payment channels, evaluating the potential of different data fields to enhance our fraud detection, experimenting with different modelling approaches and enhancements, recognizing seasonal patterns, and creating reliable forecasts. Your contributions will extend beyond immediate solutions, serving as a catalyst for ongoing improvements in our fraud detection capabilities through model experimentation and the integration of new data elements. In addition to your focused problem-solving efforts, you will be collaborating with others to brainstorm how data science solutions can help us stay one step ahead of criminals in the ongoing cat-and-mouse game.

ABN AMRO is a future driven bank that is working continuously on unlocking the power of data: you will be part of this transformation!

Working environment

Grid Channel Security within Corporate Information Security Office (CISO) is responsible for the prevention and detection of payment fraud, and deciding the policy and strategy in the area of fraud. The Fraud Monitoring team that you are going to be part of, is a motivated multidisciplinary group of approximately 25 colleagues working with a focus on protecting customers. We work in a hybrid way and our day to day work is organized by the agile and scrum principles. CISO is recognised as having an informal work atmosphere where everyone has a heart for their job and is prepared to help others.

Your profile

We are looking for a data scientist with strong technical and problem-solving skills, as well as a collaborative mindset. We strongly emphasize that there are no "lone wolves" on our team. You should care deeply about helping your colleagues, mentoring, and coaching where possible, while maintaining a learning mindset.

Required Qualifications and technical skills:

A master’s degree or PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, etc.).
5 years of independent machine learning development experience, including exploratory data analysis, model experimentation, and collaborating with engineers for model deployment in real-world applications.
Demonstrated professional experience developing ML models in a big data environment (e.g., Spark, distributed computing frameworks).
Strong working knowledge of Python, SQL, and Spark.
Familiarity with MLOps concepts such as lineage, reproducibility, and model monitoring, and experience with tools like MLFlow.
An understanding of the full data science lifecycle and an ability to make trade-off decisions around key concepts such as sampling, cross-validation, model evaluation metrics, and feature engineering.
Experience working in a professional software development environment, such as appropriate use of Git, code reviews, code packaging, and orchestration of jobs.
Strong technical communication skills; capable of presenting data science work to either business or highly technical stakeholders. You should see the value in technical documentation.
Project management skills: you understand how to scope modelling projects. You have experience working in an Agile environment.

Preferred team values:

A demonstrated ability to innovate and think creatively to solve complex technical puzzles.
You display persistence and intellectual curiosity to ensure that not only is work complete, but the problem at hand is truly solved.
You are proactive in solving problems; reaching outing to stakeholders as and when necessary, ask for reviews or brainstorming sessions with your team, suggesting new ideas to solve existing problems.
In addition to meeting the above requirements, please write a one-page cover letter describing how your experience meetings the required qualifications and describe a few scenarios where you have demonstrated our teams' values.

We are offering

We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing.

In addition, we offer:

An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget.
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.

You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.

Interested?

Does this opportunity sound like something you’d be interested in? Please send us your application as soon as possible. We look forward to meeting you.

Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable

At ABN AMRO, we believe in " Banking for better, for generations to come.
" Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of being a personal bank in the digital age
aligns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future.

If you want to apply for the B-Able or Reboot program, make sure to mention it both in the title and the content of your resume.

Disclaimer external recruitment agencies

External recruitment agencies need to have a signed agreement with ABN AMRO BANK N.V., executed by a Talent Acquisition Specialist, when submitting a resume to a vacancy. No unsolicited services or offers, please.

Use of AI in our application process

You’re welcome to use AI to help write your CV or cover letter, as long as it reflects your own story. We review every application personally and without AI. During interviews, real time AI tools may not be used. With your permission, interviews can be recorded and supported by AI. This helps us keep the process fair, careful, and transparent.

jobs.title: Security Compliance Analyst
jobs.location: Hedehusene, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Job Req Number: 127919

Time Type: Full Time

DSV is one of the world’s largest transport and logistics companies, and our customers, partners and regulators expect us to know how secure we are at any given time. That expectation grows every year, and it makes the work of measuring and reporting on security more important than ever – we are only as strong as our ability to see where we stand.

As Security Compliance Analyst, you will build and maintain that picture through security metrics and key controls, which gives senior management and the Board of Directors a clear, data-based view to support their decisions and helps keep our global operations secure, compliant and reliable.

Your role and impact

The role is part of a broader GRC agenda, and you will contribute to initiatives across information security, governance, regulatory and compliance. Much of your work is done in collaboration with security specialists across IT, who hold the detailed knowledge your reporting depends on. Getting the right input from them, and agreeing on what should be measured and how, calls for strong collaboration skills and a diplomatic approach.

You will have ownership of your area and room to develop it. Senior management and the Board of Directors read what you write, so clear and well-structured writing is a core part of the role. You thrive in a changing environment, keep things moving and make sure decisions get made.

You will join the Security Governance & Risk team within Group Information Security & Compliance. We are a diverse team of 16 skilled colleagues with a collaborative culture. At DSV we work physical from the office four days a week, which keeps dialogue informal and makes it easy to involve colleagues early. In this role, you will work closely with the management in the team as well as the CISO from our office in Hedehusene.

Your primary tasks:

Drive and continuously improve the security metrics process and the key control framework, in close collaboration with security specialists across IT.
Support updates to information security policies and ensure they are reflected in controls and metrics.
Analyse security data and control attestations to identify trends, risks and areas that need attention.
Translate complex IT security data into clear, structured reporting that supports decision-making for senior management and the Board of Directors.
Contribute to projects and initiatives across the GRC team where structure, analysis and follow-through are needed.

Success in this role comes from getting the right data in on time, maintaining a strong working relationship with specialists across IT, and delivering reporting that decision-makers can rely on.

What You Bring

You are analytical by nature and have worked with several parts of the field, for example security metrics, IT controls, compliance frameworks or policy work. You understand how policies, controls and metrics depend on each other, and that understanding is what makes your reporting solid and convincing.

You are familiar with frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIS2 or similar, and you understand how they connect to controls and metrics. Certifications such as CISA, CISM or CISSP are an advantage but not a requirement.

Your educational background may be in IT, information security, business administration or a related field; what matters most is your ability to work with security data and turn it into a clear message that senior management and a non-technical audience can understand.

You could for example have a background as a business analyst, where you have built reporting and analysis across different parts of an organisation and are used to getting data from people who have other priorities. Or you could have held responsibility for security reporting, control testing or compliance in a large organisation. What matters most is that you thrive in an environment where priorities move, that you are proactive in your work and have a diplomatic mind that gets collaboration moving.

Why join DSV

As Security Compliance Analyst, you will have the opportunity to shape how security is measured and reported in one of the world’s largest transport and logistics companies, where your work will be seen and used at the highest level of the organisation.

You will become part of a performance-driven organisation where decisions are made close to the business and where there is room to take initiative, recommend a direction and follow the work through.

Application process

Include your CV and a cover letter in which we can read why you find this role motivating. If you have any questions, you can contact: Director Nathalie Viuf Stender, nathalie.stender@dsv.com

The application deadline is 23 November 2026.

DSV – Global transport and logistics

What moves you?

Hos DSV flytter vi mere end bare varer. Vi flytter karrierer, ambitioner og muligheder.

Med tæt på 150.000 kolleger i mere end 90 lande er vi verdens førende transport- og logistikvirksomhed, og det er vores medarbejdere, der hver dag gør vores services og løsninger til virkelighed. Fra lagermedarbejdere til stabs- og forretningsfunktioner bidrager hver rolle til at holde forsyningskæder i bevægelse og samfundet kørende.

Her får du tillid til at tage ansvar, handle på dine idéer og træffe beslutninger, der skaber reel værdi. Det er et sted, hvor mennesker, karrierer og idéer hele tiden bevæger sig fremad. Vi værdsætter åbenhed i den måde, vi kommunikerer og samarbejder på, og vi skaber resultater sammen ved at støtte hinanden, udfordre hinanden og levere som ét team.

Start here. Go anywhere

Det er vores løfte om bevægelse. Et løfte om, at dit arbejde betyder noget, dit bidrag tæller, og din karriere kan udvikle sig lige så langt, som dine ambitioner rækker.

Hvis du ønsker at gøre en forskel, udvikle din karriere og blive en del af noget større, er DSV det rette sted for dig.

Besøg dsv.com og følg os på LinkedIn, Instagram og Facebook.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Our Team

We are looking for three Automation Engineers who are eager to develop their expertise and make an impact within a dynamic and supportive team. DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where your ideas matter. We're building a culture that values collaboration, continuous learning, and making a difference. As an employee at DESMI, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects, develop cutting-edge skills, and connect with a diverse team of talented individuals. If you're looking for a workplace where you can grow, contribute, and be inspired, DESMI is the place for you.

Ideally, We Are Looking For Someone Who Is

Curious and eager to explore new technologies and solutions
Driven by solving technical challenges and delivering high-quality results
Collaborative and motivated by working across disciplines to create robust solutions

A glimpse into the role

As an Automation Engineer, you will become part of a global Automation team with 8 colleagues in Denmark and 2 colleagues in China. Automation is a key strategic focus at DESMI, and you will play an important role in further developing and strengthening our automation solutions.

We are expanding our team and are looking for engineers with different strengths and interests. Whether your expertise lies in PLC and software development, electrical and hardware design, system integration, or technical leadership, you will help develop robust and reliable automation solutions across DESMI's product portfolio. Working closely with colleagues across Product Development, Engineering, Production, Service, and Sales, you will contribute to delivering high-quality solutions that create value for our customers.

Depending on your strengths and interest, your main responsibilities could include:

Development and maintenance of automation solutions for DESMI products and systems
Design and implementation of PLC and HMI software
Development and integration of electrical, control, and communication systems
Participation in system testing, commissioning, and technical verification
Preparation of technical documentation and support material
Technical support for DESMI's global organization
Driving continuous improvements of products, processes, and technical quality
Ensuring solutions can be efficiently handed over to Production and Service

Your next opportunity starts here

As someone who will join our Automation Team, we are looking for a skilled engineer who is a self-driven individual with expertise in automation technology, electrical engineering, or a related field.

We Also Imagine That You

Have an educational background within Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
Have experience with automation systems, PLC programming, electrical systems, or a combination of these disciplines
Enjoy solving technical challenges and turning complex requirements into practical solutions
Have a structured approach to your work and take ownership of your tasks
Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with colleagues across functions and locations
Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken

It would be an advantage if you have experience with:

PLC platforms such as Siemens Step 7 and TIA Portal
Hardware design, electrical schematics, and documentation in SEE Electrical or similar CAD tools
Industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus TCP/IP, or Profinet
Pumping systems, water treatment systems, or other industrial applications
Marine, defense, or other highly regulated industries

The perks of being at DESMI

At DESMI, we want you to feel supported, valued and motivated. That’s why we offer a range of benefits that make a difference – from flexibility and career opportunities to security.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Flexible working hours With the option to work from home two days a week, supporting a hybrid work environment that fosters productivity and teamwork.
Global career prospects Be part of DESMI’s global team. Working with dedicated colleagues across Europe, Asia and USA.
Skills development and career growth Opportunities for training, job rotation and internal mobility.
Pension With employer contributions up to 10% depending on your contract type.
Private healthcare and life insurance Your well-being is important to us. We provide comprehensive private healthcare coverage, giving you access to quality medical treatment when needed.
On-site canteen Including a light breakfast, lunch buffet and fruit snacks throughout the day, with a focus on healthy and varied meals.
Company sports & social activities Join events like badminton, bowling, summer parties, art clubs and more.

What We’re About

But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.

When You Join DESMI, You Can Expect

A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.

As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?

If you're a motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply through the platform!

To learn more about this opportunity please contact Søren Flummer at sorf@desmi.com . We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Arbetsplatsbeskrivning

Är du redo för en större uppgift?

Polismyndigheten är Sveriges största myndighet med ca 42 000 medarbetare över hela landet. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till Polisens uppdrag – att öka tryggheten och minska brottsligheten i samhället.

Serviceavdelningen ansvarar för att stärka polisens möte med allmänheten och organisationer och deras behov av service, nationellt såväl som regionalt. Avdelningen ansvarar bland annat för vapenärenden, utdrag ur misstanke- och belastningsregister samt, i samverkan med polisregionerna, pass och andra ID-handlingar. Vi hanterar även utlämnandeärenden. Vårt uppdrag är att stötta det brottsförebyggande och brottsbekämpande arbetet genom att säkerställa Polisens tillgänglighet mot medborgare. Detta gör vi via digitala tjänster, telefoni och Polisens servicekontor i nära samarbete med övriga delar av organisationen

Gruppen Digitala Tjänster består av verksamhetsutvecklare som driver utveckling av polisens kontakt med medborgare via olika kanaler som digitala tjänster, Mina sidor, samtal via 11414, digital post och e-post. Vi söker nu en verksamhetsutvecklare med erfarenhet av utveckling av service via telefonilösningar och digitala tjänster till vår serviceavdelning.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vi söker dig som vill utveckla polisens service, främst via telefon men även genom att förbättra medborgarens hela upplevelse i alla kanaler – från digitala tjänster och e-post till fysiska möten på servicekontor.

I rollen förväntas du analysera, beskriva och driva förändring med ett helhetsperspektiv. Du har förståelse för hur medborgaren och verksamheten påverkar varandra, samt hur förändringar får konsekvenser för hela systemet. Du sätter effektmål, planerar uppföljning och arbetar tillsammans med IT och verksamheten för att ta fram behovsanalyser och lösningsförslag. Rollen innebär mycket samverkan inom myndigheten och arbete med en stor bredd av ärenden

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har:

En akademisk examen eller annan relevant utbildning alternativt arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig
Flera års dokumenterad erfarenhet av att självständigt genomföra verksamhetsanalyser eller arbete med kundresor och användarupplevelser
Erfarenhet av att omvandla behov till krav och konkreta förslag på utvecklingsaktiviteter
Erfarenhet av att självständigt leda och koordinera komplex verksamhetsutveckling med inriktning på digitalisering
God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska
Svenskt medborgarskap

Det är meriterande om du har:

Erfarenhet av kontaktcenter och telefonilösningar. Både verksamhetserfarenhet och förståelse för tekniska lösningar är relevant.
Arbetet med service- eller tjänstedesign
Erfarenhet av arbete med att ta fram effektmål och uppföljning av mål
Erfarenhet av förändringsledning
Arbetat med kravställning för upphandling av tjänster eller system

PERSONLIGA EGENSKAPER

Vi söker dig som är engagerad, strukturerad, har ett agilt mindset och stort tålamod. Du trivs med att arbeta i grupp och drivs av ditt teams framgångar samtidigt som du är självgående och bekväm med att fatta egna beslut och göra prioriteringar. Du behöver ha förmåga att skifta fokus och kunna hantera nya förutsättningar i uppdragen.

Då tjänsten innebär interaktion med många olika roller och verksamheter är det viktigt att du är en god kommunikatör som anpassar din kommunikation till de olika personer och grupper du samverkar med. Tycker du dessutom att det är roligt att inspirera andra och delar med dig av din kunskap kommer du att trivas hos oss.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer – Python & SIL Simulation
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad testautomation där Python, simulering och inbyggda system står i centrum? Trivs du med att utveckla script, bygga komplexa testscenarier och automatisera verifiering av tekniska system i realtidsnära simuleringsmiljöer? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig.

Vi söker nu en Test Automation Engineer med starka kunskaper i Python och erfarenhet av att utveckla automatiserade testscenarier i simuleringsmiljöer. Hos oss blir du en del av vårt team inom mekatronik och inbyggda system, där vi kombinerar programmering, systemförståelse och avancerad testteknik för att utveckla framtidens produkter.

Om rollen

Som Test Automation Engineer får du en central roll i utvecklingen av automatiserade testlösningar för komplexa tekniska system. Tyngdpunkten ligger på praktisk programmering i Python, där du utvecklar script, bygger upp testscenarier och skapar automatiserade testflöden för verifiering av systemfunktioner.

Ett särskilt fokus ligger på Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), där mjukvara och systembeteenden testas i simulerade miljöer. Du arbetar med att skapa och konfigurera scenarier som representerar olika driftförhållanden, händelseförlopp och systembeteenden, samt automatiserar exekvering och analys av testresultat.

Rollen passar dig som tycker om att skriva kod, utveckla testverktyg och förstå hur komplexa system fungerar. Du har gärna erfarenhet av både simulerade testmiljöer och hårdvarunära verifiering, där samspelet mellan mjukvara, elektronik och systemfunktioner är centralt.

Hos våra kunder får du möjlighet att arbeta med avancerad produktutveckling inom exempelvis försvar, fordon, medicinteknik, elektrifiering, industriell automation och robotik.

I rollen kommer du bland annat jobba med:

Omfattande scriptutveckling i Python för testautomation, simulering och verifiering.
Utveckling, konfigurering och underhåll av automatiserade testscenarier i Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) och andra simuleringsmiljöer.
Uppbyggnad av scenarier som simulerar systembeteenden, driftförhållanden och tidsberoende händelseförlopp.
Utveckling av testscript, testverktyg och ramverk för automatiserad testexekvering.
Automatisering av testflöden, datainsamling, loggning och analys av simuleringsresultat.
Felsökning och verifiering av inbyggda system och deras funktioner.
Integration av automatiserade tester i CI/CD-miljöer.
Versionshantering och källkodshantering med exempelvis GitHub eller GitLab.

Din profil:

Vi tror att du har en bakgrund inom mjukvarunära testautomation, systemverifiering eller utveckling av inbyggda system och trivs i en roll där programmering är en stor del av det dagliga arbetet.

Du är van att självständigt skriva och vidareutveckla script, bygga automatiserade testscenarier och analysera resultat från komplexa testmiljöer. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och förstår vikten av robusta, återanvändbara och effektiva testlösningar.

Samtidigt har du ett tekniskt intresse som sträcker sig utanför själva programmeringen och vill förstå hur mjukvara, hårdvara och systembeteenden hänger ihop.

Du uppskattar dialogen med både kunder och kollegor, har lätt för att bygga förtroende och kan kommunicera tekniska frågeställningar på ett pedagogiskt sätt. Som konsult är du flexibel, lyhörd och van att samarbeta i tvärfunktionella team för att hitta de bästa lösningarna.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom mekatronik, elektroteknik, datateknik eller motsvarande kompetens.
Några års erfarenhet av testautomation, mjukvaruverifiering eller utveckling av tekniska system.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och dokumenterad erfarenhet av omfattande scriptutveckling.
Praktisk erfarenhet av att självständigt utveckla automatiserade testfall och testscenarier.
Erfarenhet av scriptning och automatisering i simuleringsmiljöer, gärna SIL eller motsvarande.
Förståelse för tidsberoende systembeteenden, inbyggda system och samspelet mellan hårdvara och mjukvara.
Erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git.
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Meriterande:

Du har erfarenhet av:

Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) eller modellbaserad verifiering.
Realtidssystem och simulering av tidskritiska funktioner.
Produktutveckling inom försvar, automotive, industri, medicinteknik eller andra teknikintensiva branscher.
Testautomationsramverk såsom pytest eller Robot Framework.
CI/CD-verktyg såsom Jenkins, GitLab CI eller liknande.
Linuxbaserade utvecklings- och testmiljöer.
Containerteknologier såsom Docker.
Kommunikationsprotokoll såsom CAN, Ethernet eller andra industriella gränssnitt.
Systemintegration och hårdvarunära felsökning i labb- eller testbänksmiljöer.

Därför ska du välja oss:

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med tekniskt avancerade utvecklingsprojekt som ligger nära framtidens produkter och teknik. Våra kunder finns inom flera teknikintensiva branscher där krav på kvalitet, innovation och teknisk spetskompetens är höga.

Du får kombinera spännande kunduppdrag med tryggheten, kunskapsutbytet och gemenskapen i ett erfaret konsultteam. Vi tror på att utvecklas tillsammans och att våra medarbetare ska ha möjlighet att påverka både sin egen vardag och företagets utveckling.

Hos oss finns korta beslutsvägar, stort förtroende och goda möjligheter att engagera sig inom exempelvis affärsutveckling, mentorskap, kompetensnätverk och rekrytering.

Oavsett om du vill fördjupa din tekniska kompetens, ta större tekniskt ansvar eller bidra till utvecklingen av framtidens produkter finns det utrymme att forma din egen resa hos oss.

Vårt moderna kontor vid Liljeholmskajen erbjuder fantastisk utsikt över vattnet samt närhet till restauranger, gym och goda kommunikationer.

VI ERBJUDER

Vi är stora nog för att kunna erbjuda en bred kundbas och vi har ett gott rykte i branschen, samtidigt som vi är små nog att se dig som individ. För oss är gemenskap viktigt – här ska alla känna sig sedda och välkomna. Som en följd av detta har vi bland annat gemensamma sektionsaktiviteter, ett nätverk för kvinnor och icke-binära, ett mentorskapsprogam och utbildningar inom olika kompetensområden. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla kan växa och utvecklas tillsammans.

Vår ambition är att tillgodose konsultens önskemål gällande uppdragslängd, sektor och arbetsuppgifter. För oss är en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv en självklarhet och vi är stolta över att vara en av Sveriges mest attraktiva arbetsgivare. Givetvis har vi också kollektivavtal.

Nyfiken på hur det känns att vara en del av vårt gäng? I den här filmen delar några av våra medarbetare med sig av sina tankar om vardagen, gemenskapen och varför de valt just oss: https://vimeo.com/1058313176?share=copy#t=0

OM SID

Sigma Industry Development är ett teknik- och konsultbolag inom Sigmagruppen som hjälper både ledande svenska och internationella teknikföretag och innovativa och nytänkande start-ups och scale-ups. Vi verkar inom sektorer så som den gröna energisektorn, fordonsindustrin, transportindustrin, medtech, försvarsbranchen och hållbarhet.

Vår vision är att vara det ledande teknikkonsultbolaget och vår kultur präglas av familjär samhörighet där människan är i centrum. Med över 100 engagerade medarbetare är vi i en stark tillväxtfas. Vår kärnverksamhet ligger i konsultuppdrag ute hos kund, men vi har även ett in-house-team som arbetar uteslutande från kontoret. Precis som vårt namn antyder, är utveckling kärnan i allt vi gör och våra medarbetare engageras av att ta Sigma Industry Development till nästa nivå.

OM SIGMA GROUP

Sigma Industry Development AB (SID) är ett av sex dotterbolag som ingår i koncernen Sigma Industry East/North Group, vilka i sin tur ingår i Sigma Group (som ägs av familjekoncernen Danir AB). Läs mer om Sigma Industry Development  HÄR

jobs.title: Digital Platform Leader Agentic Retail | Retail Concept Operations  | Inter IKEA
jobs.description:
Job Description

Hej Digital Platform Leader for Agentic Retail

Inter IKEA Group connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and ensures alignment of the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone.

This role is positioned in Retail Concept Operations. You will belong to the Retail Digital Operations team, reporting to the Platform Area Manager.

In Retail Concept Operations, as part of Retail Concept, we protect, develop, and enable the IKEA Concept across markets and franchisees. We turn the "what" of the IKEA Concept into the "how" of everyday retail operations, making it easy to use, scale, and trust across the value chain.

We take pride in working in progressive ways of working, with empowered teams and strong digital competence. We focus on simple, practical solutions that strengthen both short- and long-term low cost, while supporting consistency and quality in how the IKEA Concept comes to life.

Together, we build ways of working where teams take ownership, collaborate closely, and continuously improve, so we can create meaningful value for IKEA, our franchisees, co-workers, and the many people.

Our team enables digital platforms that support the IKEA Concept across markets and franchisees, making it easier for products, services and teams to work together in a secure, scalable and reliable way. Together, we continuously improve developer experience and platform capabilities to create value across the IKEA value chain.

Our team is based in Malmö. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.

About The Role

You will shape the platform that enables the next generation of agentic retail operations across IKEA and our franchisees. Combining strategic thinking with hands-on leadership, you will define its vision and roadmap, align with internal enabling functions and advance capabilities in the Microsoft ecosystem, including Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry and Agent 365. A central challenge is enabling agents to work together across our internal and retail tenants and retailers' separate tenants, with clear security and data boundaries. Working closely with developers, product teams, architects and suppliers, you will turn emerging opportunities into practical platform capabilities while ensuring operational excellence and continuous improvement. This is an exciting opportunity for a co-worker with experience in digital product, platform or technology development to take the next step in platform leadership and support IKEA's digital transformation journey.

You will lead a team that combines platform engineering with hands-on support to the business. Two Forward Deployed Engineers work directly inside the product teams in the capability area Retail Commercial and Customer, helping them find valuable use cases, build their first agents and move from experiment to production. Your job is to make that support repeatable: turn what the engineers learn into reusable capabilities, patterns and platform improvements, and align these with internal enabling functions so teams can adopt them consistently. By connecting practical retail needs with shared platform capabilities, you will help our work create lasting value in homes and hearts across the world.

On a Typical Working Day, You Will

Define and communicate the platform vision, roadmap and priorities to stakeholders and platform users.
Lead backlog management, release planning and prioritisation to ensure the platform delivers value to developers and digital products.
Collaborate with product teams, architects, suppliers and developers to remove dependencies, solve challenges and continuously improve platform capabilities.

What We'd Like You To Bring To The Table

The role as a Digital Platform Leader requires you to:

Have experience in digital product, platform or software development, ideally within agile or DevOps environments, and be able to turn emerging AI and agent capabilities into reusable solutions that teams can take from experimentation to production.
Demonstrate a strong understanding of developer needs and software engineering practices.
Lead through collaboration, creating alignment across teams, stakeholders and suppliers.
Make informed decisions using both qualitative and quantitative data.
Communicate effectively with technical and business audiences and translate complexity into simple, actionable outcomes.
Drive continuous improvement and deliver results in a fast-moving digital environment.
Be fluent in spoken and written English.

It's a Plus If You Also

Have experience building or managing internal platforms, developer platforms or shared technology capabilities.
Have experience with platform performance measurement, operational excellence and service management.
Bring knowledge of modern technology landscapes, cloud platforms or digital ecosystem development.

We welcome your application

We look forward to receiving your application by the 20th October 2026 at the latest. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, or if you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, feel free to contact the Recruiter Jordi Menick (jordi.menick@inter.ikea.com)

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in Inter IKEA Systems Service AB, Inter IKEA Technology Services AB and Inter IKEA Systems BV and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

jobs.title: Data Engineer MarTech
jobs.description:
Every week, millions of people turn to us when they’re looking for a new home, or just imagining one. Reaching them with the right message at the right time really matters.

That’s where Martech comes in, right where marketing meets tech. Marketing has plenty of ideas about how we can reach our users in smarter, more relevant ways, and making them happen takes someone who understands both the data and the people behind it.

As our new Data Engineer in Martech, you’ll be the bridge. You’ll translate marketing ideas into technical solutions, and explain technical possibilities and limitations in a way that makes sense to Marketing. You’ll dig into a setup that has grown over time, work out what’s what, and help shape what it should become.

It’s a role with real impact and plenty of room to make your mark. You won’t just be maintaining something. You’ll help build the foundation for more intelligent communication that helps people find their way home.

What You'll Be Up To 🍏

You’ll support Martech as an area, owning both the day-to-day operation of what we have today and the development of what comes next. Keeping things running is only half the job. The other half is moving us forward, from where we are to where we should be.

In short, you’ll:

Run and improve our existing Martech setup
Move logic and content out of our core platform so Marketing can own it our CRM system in Customer.io
Work closely with Marketing to understand their needs and turn them into solutions
Build towards smarter, data-driven communication using our real-time platform

Who We Think You Are 🤩

You’re a self-starter who takes initiative and gets things done without waiting to be told. You also have the people skills to read the room. You check in, ask the right questions and make sure you’re heading in the same direction as everyone else before you run. In addition you’re curious and eager to learn. You enjoy digging deep, untangling tricky problems and figuring out how things actually work.

In short, you’re:

Flexible. You adapt as things shift, and they will.
Curious. You want to understand, not just patch.
Ownership-minded. You take responsibility and follow through.
A team player. You win with the team, not on your own.

Requirements

Experience building and running API integrations with external platforms in production, ideally a CRM or marketing platform, including rate limits, monitoring and incident handling.
Experience working closely with non-technical teams, including turning their needs into technical solutions, explaining trade-offs and setting expectations.
Strong skills in SQL and data modelling, including event data at volume.
Experience building and running event-driven data flows, including retries, duplicates, ordering and backfills.
Hands-on experience with analytical databases or data warehouses.

Bonus

Experience with TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, which our current integration service is built on.
Experience with ClickHouse, BigQuery, dbt, Prefect or Kafka, which our data platform uses.
Experience integrating with Customer.io, Braze or a similar customer messaging platform.
Experience with consent, identity across systems and deletion in customer data.

I am your new manager
👋

Hi, I am Helena and will be your new manager. A little about me: I’m engaged and I care about the people around me and about the work we do together. I see each person as an individual, and I see my job as giving you what you need to succeed and grow. That will look different for everyone, so I’ll be asking and listening a lot in the beginning.

You can expect me to be clear and direct, and to bring structure so we know where we’re going and why. I’d rather say things openly than leave you guessing, and I expect you’ll do the same with me.

I believe this team has the potential to deliver the really exciting things, the kind that make Hemnet the very best property portal, and I want us to do more of that. Getting there also takes groundwork, from the platform to data quality, and I’m excited to take that on together with you.

I also have a technical background in data, so I have a pretty good grasp of what goes into the work, and I still enjoy building things myself.

A Note on Inclusion
💚

At Hemnet, we believe that diversity in gender, sexual orientation, ability, neurodiversity, cultural background and life experience makes us stronger. We welcome applicants of all identities and backgrounds.

If you meet many of the requirements (even if you don’t meet all of them), we’d still love for you to apply. We’re big on curiosity, a strong sense of purpose, and a real motivation to learn and grow along with your skills and experience.

A Hybrid Way of Working
🏡

Our vibrant office in central Stockholm is the hub of our collaboration and culture, providing a lively space that fosters team spirit. We come together in the office three days a week, with two flexible remote days. To be part of our team, it’s essential to be based in or near Stockholm.

Please note we are currently not sponsoring any relocation.

jobs.description:
Vil du være med og forme hva vi bygger innen Data & AI?

Vi har erfaring og spennende kundeprosjekter å bygge videre på, og nå ser vi etter flere som vil være med og forme veien videre.

Derfor ser vi etter deg som har noen års praktisk erfaring som Data Scientist, og som ønsker å bruke data til å løse reelle forretningsproblemer. Hos oss får du jobbe med hele reisen fra å forstå problemet og utforske data, til å utvikle modeller og få løsningene til å skape verdi i praksis.

Du får ikke bare en rolle i kundeprosjektene våre, men også muligheten til å påvirke hvordan vi jobber, hva vi satser på og hvordan Data & AI-fagmiljøet vårt utvikler seg.

Dette ser vi etter

Relevant høyere utdanning innen teknologi, informatikk, statistikk, matematikk eller tilsvarende
Noen års praktisk erfaring med Data Science, maskinlæring eller avansert analyse
God forståelse for statistikk, prediktiv modellering og evaluering av modeller
Erfaring med Python og relevante biblioteker for analyse og maskinlæring
Erfaring med å bearbeide, utforske og analysere større datasett
Forståelse for hvordan modeller kan tas fra eksperimentering til løsninger som faktisk brukes
Evne til å forstå forretningsproblemer og oversette dem til gode analytiske problemstillinger
Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

Det er et pluss om du også har erfaring med

Azure Machine Learning, Databricks eller Microsoft Fabric
MLOps og produksjonssetting, monitorering og videreutvikling av modeller
Generativ AI, RAG eller utvikling av løsninger basert på store språkmodeller
Tidsserieanalyse og prognoser
Optimalisering, klassifisering eller andre metoder for beslutningsstøtte

Hvorfor Itera?

Itera er et teknologidrevet konsulentselskap der teknologi, design og forretning møtes. Vi jobber sammen om komplekse kundeutfordringer, og kombinerer sterke fagmiljøer med korte veier fra idé til handling.

Hos oss får du:
Faglig utvikling
, gjennom kurs, sertifiseringer, faggrupper og læring i prosjekter
Tverrfaglighet
, med kolleger innen data, AI, software, design og forretning
Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Aksjeprogram

Et sosialt og inkluderende miljø
, med både faglige og sosiale aktiviteter

Og kanskje viktigst: Du får mennesker rundt deg som liker å dele det de kan, spørre om det de ikke kan og finne løsninger sammen.

Kanskje dette er neste steg for deg?

Kjenner du deg igjen i det vi beskriver, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg. Du trenger ikke kunne alt på listen. Det viktigste for oss er at du har et godt fundament innen data og analyse, er nysgjerrig på hvordan teknologi kan løse reelle problemer og ønsker å utvikle deg videre sammen med flinke folk.

jobs.title: Rådgjevar innan digital informasjonsforvaltning og utvikling
jobs.description:
Som rådgjevar innan digital informasjonsforvaltning og utvikling vil du få

vere med å utvikle korleis NTNU forvaltar, deler og nyttar informasjon på ein framtidsretta og berekraftig måte.

I denne stillinga får du arbeide i skjeringspunktet der teknologi møter fag og menneske. Du vil støtte tilsette i arbeidskvardagen, gjere komplekse tema forståelege og bidra til smartare og meir brukarvennlege arbeidsprosessar.

NTNU moderniserar no saksbehandlings- og arkivområdet, mellom anna gjennom overgangen frå Elements til WebSak. Du får høve til å ta del i denne utviklinga og bidra med opplæring, rådgiving, systemstøtte og forbetring av digitale løysingar.

Ved NTNU får du ein variert arbeidskvardag, ei brei kontaktflate og høve til å påverke utviklinga av fagområdet. Du blir ein del av eit sterkt fagmiljø som deler kunnskap, utforskar nye løysingar og samarbeider på tvers av campusane ved NTNU.

Arbeidsplassen din er ved campus Ålesund, med tett samarbeid med kollega ved NTNUs øvrige campus. Du får ei sentral rolle i utviklinga av framtidas informasjonsforvaltning ved NTNU, samt varierte arbeidsoppgåver innan digitalisering, automatisering, KI og nye systemløysingar. Du vil også få ta del i eit sterkt, tverrfagleg fagmiljø med gode moglegheiter for utvikling og påverknad i lag med 32 andre medarbeidarar.

Du vert tilsett i seksjon for informasjonsforvaltning. Seksjonssjefen er din næraste leiar.

Kva vil arbeidskvardagen din bestå av?

Opplæring og kompetanseutvikling

Planlegge og gjennomføre opplæring og utvikle digitale læringsressurser for saksbehandlere.

Rådgivning og veiledning

Gi råd om informasjonsforvaltning, dokumentasjon, saksbehandling og relevant regelverk.

Systemstøtte og brukerstøtte

Bistå brukere og utføre systemadministrative oppgaver i aktuelle saksbehandlingsløsninger.

Utvikling av systemer og arbeidsprosesser

Bidra til innføring av WebSak og forbedring av rutiner, systemer og integrasjoner.

Digitalisering, automatisering og KI

Utforske og ta i bruk teknologi som kan effektivisere og forbedre NTNUs tjenester.

Kvalitet og kontinuerlig forbedring

Utføre arkivfaglige oppgaver og bidra til kvalitet, etterlevelse og videreutvikling av fagområdet.

For å vere kvalifisert for stillinga, må du ha

relevant høgare utdanning på minimum bachelornivå. Omfattande relevant erfaring kan kompensere for utdanningskravet
relevant erfaring frå informasjons- og dokumentasjonsforvaltning, arkiv eller saksbehandling
erfaring med sak- og arkivsystem eller andre relevante informasjonsforvaltningsverktøy
erfaring frå offentleg forvaltning og kjennskap til relevant lov- og regelverk
god digital kompetanse og samarbeidsevne
god munnleg og skriftleg framstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk

Det er ein fordel om du også har kompetanse innan:

digitalisering, automatisering eller bruk av kunstig intelligens
opplæring, kompetanseutvikling og formidling
systemadministrasjon, testing, brukarstøtte, databasar eller integrasjonar
arkivfagleg arbeid og utvikling av effektive arbeidsprosessar
universitets- og høgskulesektoren eller anna offentleg verksemd

Vi forventar ikkje at du kan alt. Det viktigaste er at du er nysgjerrig på nye løysingar og motivert for å utvikle deg saman med oss.

For å trivast og lykkast godt i stillinga, ser vi for oss at du er

nysgjerrig, utviklingsorientert og ser moglegheiter for forbetring. Du tek initiativ, arbeider sjølvstendig og systematisk og finn gode løysingar på utfordringar. Du kommuniserer tydeleg og gjer komplekse problemstillingar forståelege. Samtidig samarbeider du godt med andre, deler kunnskap og bidreg til eit godt fagmiljø på tvers av dei ulike campusane.

Ved vurdering av den best kvalifiserte, legg vi vekt på utdanning, erfaring og personleg eignaheit, samt din motivasjon for stillinga.

Dette kan vi tilby om du vel oss som din arbeidsgivar

spennande og utviklande oppgåver i eit sterkt og internasjonalt fagmiljø
opent og inkluderande arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer
gunstige vilkår i Statens pensjonskasse
tilsettegoder og fordelar
vere ein del av eit universitet som arbeidar målretta for å vere verdsleiande i sine felt

Løn og vilkår som er gjeldande for stillinga

I stillingskode 1434 rådgjevar vil du normalt lønast frå brutto kr 600 000 til kr 680 000 pr. år avhengig av kvalifikasjonar. I stillingskode 1364 som seniorrådgjevar vil du normalt lønast frå brutto kr 700 000 til kr 800 000. For særleg godt kvalifiserte søkarar kan ein noko høgare lønsinnplassering vurderast. Frå løna vert det trekt 2 % lovfesta innskot til Statens pensjonskasse.

Tilsettinga vert gjennomført etter prinsippa i statsansatteloven, og lovverk som regulerar eksport av kunnskap, teknologi og tenester. Etter tilsettinga må du rekne med at det kan skje endringar i arbeidsområdet.

Viktig å vete om søknaden din

Vi gjer merksam på at søknaden berre blir vurdert ut frå informasjonen som ligg føre ved utløp av søknadsfrist. Sørg difor for at søknaden din tydeleg syner korleis evnar og erfaringar fyll kriteria som er beskrive over.

Søknaden Må Innehalde

CV, attestar og vitnemål

Vi ber ikkje om søknadsbrev. For oss er det meir relevant med ein beskrivande CV som syner kva du har av erfaring og kompetanse. Du må også svare på spørsmål i søknadsskjemaet, der du utdjupar di relevante erfaring og kompetanse som du meinar passar for denne stillinga.

Dersom heile eller delar av utdanninga di er gjennomført i utlandet, ber vi deg legge ved dokumentasjon på omfang og kvalitet for heile utdanningsløp ditt, både bachelor- og masterutdanning, i tillegg til anna høgare utdanning. Skildring av kva dokumentasjon som er naudsynt finn du her. Dersom du allereie har ein profil frå HK-dir, er det fint om du legg ved den også.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer III, Routing Cost
jobs.description:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers.

What We Do

The Navigation team at Mapbox develops and operates web services powering virtually all of Mapbox’s strategic navigation initiatives in consumer, automotive, and logistics verticals. We are a highly multidisciplinary organization, with work spanning distributed systems on AWS to geospatial localization, traffic telemetry, and mapping.

Collectively we are revolutionizing in-car experiences with technology to build fast, industry-leading maps and navigation for any vehicle. We’ve launched products such as MapGPT, Mapbox for EV, and we’re enhancing the visual experience of in-vehicle navigation with 3D styling with our new Mapbox Standard through web and mobile SDKs. Mapbox has worked with automotive partners — including BMW, Toyota, and GM — to bring the best aspects of mobile app development into in-vehicle navigation and infotainment.

Mapbox Blog: Introducing 3D Live Navigation
Mapbox Blog: Route Notifications Improve Driver Safety
Mapbox Newsroom: AI Features in New Navigation SDK

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do

As a Machine Learning Engineer III on the Routing Cost team, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of highly trafficked recommendation systems for our routing cost engine. Your technical contributions will include:

Lead the engineering team(s) to execute end-to-end feature implementation within the larger navigation organization (~80 engineers).
Design and build new ML and data pipelines, as well as optimizing existing ML and data pipelines.
Build tools for automated quality assurance and data exploration.
Leverage geospatial algorithms to optimize pipelines, as well as creating automated tuning and outlier detection algorithms.
Partner with data scientists to make improvements to our models for determining patterns in movement and/or traffic.
Mentor colleagues and participate in code and design reviews.
Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe Are Important Traits For This Role

8-10+ years of backend and ML experience: Extensive hands-on experience showcasing expertise and a strong track record in the engineering field.
Technical knowledge: Extensive experience with Python, distributed processing pipelines (Hadoop, Spark, Airflow, Dask), and very large datasets – statistical analysis, data quality control, optimizing storage.
Cloud proficiency: Extensive experience with cloud and infrastructure services, including, as well as deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud environments.
Operational excellence: You drive a culture of quality and continuous improvement in your organization. Strong passion for clean code and robust architecture, with a drive to elevate engineering practices and design standards across the team.
Ownership & execution: Own the technical vision, lead the strategy and guide the team to execute towards building the future of our routing cost engine.
Customer focus: You care deeply about your customers and their problems, and you work tirelessly to innovate on their behalf.
Growth mindset: Have the humility to accept mistakes, learn and grow from them.
Mentorship: Experience mentoring and leading engineering teams developing skill sets and career growth.
Strong written and vocal communication skills: You can talk and write about complex ideas concisely to a wide audience. You are able to lead and resolve org-wide technical discussions and are able to collaborate and include input from cross-functional teams (security, devops, data, compliance and product).
Data informed mindset: You believe in the value of data informed decision making and strive to measure things that are not straight forward but essential. You also have the right instincts to make speedy decisions in the absence of perfect & comprehensive data

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.
We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.
We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.
We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Would you like to build data solutions that make a real difference in how Veho operates and makes decisions?

At Veho, we have strengthened our data capabilities and developed a modern data environment based on Microsoft technologies. As we continue to develop our data platform and make better use of data across our business, we are looking for a Data Engineer
to join our Group-level Data & Analytics team.

In this role, you will work across the data and analytics stack, from building data pipelines and developing our data platform to creating data models and reporting solutions. You will play an important part in making data reliable, accessible, and valuable for our business.

What will you do?

As a Data Engineer, you will join our data platform team within the Data & Analytics function, reporting to the Head of Data. You will work closely with other Data Engineers, our Data Platform Engineer, business analysts, and stakeholders across the organization.

Your focus will be on building and improving the technical solutions that enable data to flow smoothly from different source systems into reporting and analytics. You will be involved in both new development and the continuous improvement of existing solutions, with responsibility for delivering reliable and practical results.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Building and maintaining ETL processes and data pipelines that integrate data from different source systems.
Developing and improving our data platform, including data warehousing and data processing solutions.
Designing, developing, and maintaining Power BI semantic models and reports.
Supporting the reliability, quality, and continuous improvement of our data platform and analytics solutions.
Independently delivering smaller development initiatives while contributing to the team's wider projects and goals.

You will have the opportunity to apply your technical expertise to real business challenges, develop practical solutions, and see the impact of your work across the organization.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a hands-on Data Engineer who enjoys working with modern data technologies and solving practical challenges. You have a solid technical foundation and experience in developing data solutions, but most importantly, you are motivated to learn, take responsibility, and contribute to a collaborative team.

We hope you bring:

Excellent SQL skills and good practical knowledge of Python.
Hands-on experience in building and maintaining modern data warehouses, lakehouses, or data platforms.
Experience with Microsoft cloud data technologies, particularly Azure Synapse and/or Microsoft Fabric.
Practical Power BI skills, including working with semantic models, DAX, and report development.
A good understanding of data modelling and data integration principles.
Familiarity with software development practices such as version control, testing, and CI/CD.
Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate with both technical colleagues and business stakeholders.

Experience with Microsoft Power Apps
is considered an advantage.

We value a structured, analytical, and proactive approach to work. You enjoy hands-on problem-solving, can work independently within your area of responsibility, and are eager to develop your skills. Openness, honesty, and a collaborative mindset are equally important to us.

As we work in an international environment, fluency in English is required.
Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.

Why Veho?

Meaningful work with business impact.
You will help ensure that reliable data is available for reporting, analytics, and business decision-making across our international operations.
A modern data environment and experienced colleagues.
You will join a Data & Analytics organization of approximately ten professionals, working with Microsoft technologies including Azure, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric.
A diverse international environment.
Our operations across five countries and several business areas offer opportunities to work with different data sources, systems, and business needs.
Opportunities to develop your expertise.
You will have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop your technical skills, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our data platform.

Your workplace will be at Veho's office in Aviapolis, Vantaa. We follow a hybrid working model that includes three days per week at the office. Free parking is available onsite.

Interested?

If you would like to develop data solutions that support business reporting and decision-making at Veho, we would be happy to hear from you.
