jobs.title: Finance AI & Digital Facilitator
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Finance AI & Digital Facilitator, you will help build an AI- and digital-first Finance function. You will partner with Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, Tax, Treasury and Financial Transactional Services to identify opportunities that reduce manual and transactional work and enable greater focus on business partnering, insights and decision support.
You will facilitate the definition of target states and turn identified opportunities into deliverable solutions. From the outset, the role combines transformation facilitation with agile project management and end-to-end delivery ownership. Initially, the focus will be on establishing the transformation pipeline; over time, the role will become more evenly balanced between facilitation and solution delivery.

Key responsibilities

Partner with Finance teams to identify opportunities where AI and digital solutions can fundamentally transform work, create value and increase capacity for higher-value activities.
Design and facilitate senior-level workshops that help each finance subfunction define ambitious objectives and agree on clear, business-owned target states.
Document signed-off target states, including scope, metrics, timelines and resourcing, while maintaining consistent and auditable templates and progress tracking.
Gather requirements and baseline data, conduct value and benefit analyses, and maintain business cases that demonstrate efficiency gains and changes in how Finance delivers value.
Manage multiple initiatives using agile practices, including backlog management, iteration planning, dependency and risk tracking, and delivery reporting.
Own opportunities from initial shaping through delivery, adoption and value tracking, connecting finance stakeholders with engineering teams and providing clear progress updates.

What we are looking for

Strong workshop design and facilitation skills, with experience engaging senior stakeholders, challenging established thinking and building alignment around transformational objectives.
Good understanding of finance processes—such as closing, controlling, tax, treasury or transactional services—and how digitalisation can shift work toward business partnering, analysis and decision support.
Experience in business analysis, target-state design, requirements definition, value modelling and stakeholder negotiation, together with good BI literacy.
Hands-on agile project and delivery management experience, including managing backlogs, iterations, risks and dependencies across several parallel workstreams and supporting solutions through adoption.
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business, finance, industrial engineering and management, or a related field, with relevant experience in business analysis, process consulting, agile delivery or organisational change.

Service design training and agile certifications are considered advantages.

Growth opportunities

The role will initially focus on facilitation and building the transformation pipeline across Finance. As more opportunities progress into development, the balance will shift toward agile delivery and solution ownership. Over time, the role can develop into broader programme or delivery management responsibility as the Finance transformation portfolio grows.

About the role

As a Finance AI & Digital Enablement Specialist, you will enable finance subject-matter experts to use AI and digital tools effectively in their daily work. You will lead the Finance Copilot and citizen-development programme and build an active champion community across Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, Tax, Treasury and Financial Transactional Services.

Your focus will be on scalable, finance-specific enablement—not generic tool training. Through practical use-case labs, clinics, playbooks and community activities, you will help Finance adopt secure digital solutions that deliver measurable value.

Key responsibilities

Translate AI and digital capabilities into practical finance use cases, such as closing, variance commentary, forecasting, tax checks, liquidity management and invoice or vendor handling.
Design and deliver repeatable enablement formats—including clinics, use-case labs, playbooks and showcases—that can reach finance professionals at scale.
Build and manage the Finance champion and citizen-developer community through structured onboarding, regular forums, recognition and sharing of reusable practices.
Maintain role-specific guidance that helps different finance professionals select and use the most suitable tools for their work.
Evaluate AI, agent and citizen-development tools hands-on, making clear recommendations based on capability, business fit, cost, security and scalability.

What we are looking for

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business, finance, information systems or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
Hands-on expertise in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform and comparable AI or agent tools, with the ability to build solutions, demonstrate use cases and support tool-selection decisions.
Good understanding of finance processes and the ability to identify and shape valuable use cases across areas such as controlling, tax, treasury and transactional services.
Strong experience in community building, adoption management, facilitation and communication, ideally supporting enablement initiatives at scale.

tukemaan yrityksemme kasvua, vahvistamaan brändiemme näkyvyyttä ja vauhdittamaan myyntiä tuloksellisella digitaalisella markkinoinnilla.

Pääset hyödyntämään vahvaa digitaalisen markkinoinnin osaamistasi ja viemään ideasi käytäntöön. Suunnittelet ja optimoit digitaalista markkinointia, jolla vaikutat suoraan liiketoimintamme tuloksiin.

Pääset osaksi osaavaa markkinointitiimiä, jossa tehdään yhdessä ja hyvällä fiiliksellä. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä läpi organisaation ja kumppaneiden kanssa. Raportoit strategia- ja markkinointijohtajalle.

Suunnittelet ja toteutat monikanavaisia B2B- ja B2C-kampanjoita huomioiden kohderyhmien ja ostopolkujen erot.
Rakennat ja kehität mediapanostusten ja kampanjoiden tehokkuutta, orgaanista näkyvyyttä ja maksettua mainontaa.

Sinulla on jo näyttöä siitä, miten digitaalisella markkinoinnilla vaikutetaan liiketoiminnan tuloksiin, esimerkiksi liidien ja konversioiden kasvattamisesta, mainonnan tehostamisesta ja verkkosivujen kehittämisestä. Useamman CMS-alustan hallintaa sekä kokemusta verkkosisältöjen julkaisemisesta ja käyttökokemuksen kehittämisestä, kokemus Drupalista ja WordPressistä on eduksi.
Vahvaa analytiikkaosaamista: osaat määrittää KPI:t, tulkita verkkosivujen ja mainostilien performanssia sekä rakentaa raportteja ja dashboardeja päätöksenteon tueksi.

Miksi meille?

Tässä roolissa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan digitaalisen markkinointimme kehittämiseen ja sitä kautta liiketoimintamme kasvuun. Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen, liikunta-, kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja työmatkaedun, työterveyspalvelut, joustavan hybridityön ja mahdollisuuden vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon.

Meillä työ on paljon enemmän kuin työpaikka - pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitystä. Olet tärkeä osa tiimiä, joka rakentaa brändejämme ja asiakaskokemusta. Arvostamme rohkeutta kokeilla ja tuoda omaa näkemystä esiin.

Lue lisää Sodexon henkilöstöetuusohjelmastamme Vita by Sodexo, uratarinoista ja arvoista

Work with operational stakeholders to understand business processes, challenges, and decision-making needs.
Translate business needs into clear requirements, data definitions, business rules, KPIs, and acceptance criteria for analytical and digital solutions.
Analyze data to investigate business problems, identify patterns, and support operational decision-making.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Product Owners on data modelling, technical requirements, and solution development.
Support testing and validation of reports, dashboards, data models, and analytical solutions, including data quality and accuracy.
Help stakeholders understand analytical findings, gather feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.
Ensure that solutions follow relevant data security, privacy, and governance requirements.

From You, We Wish

Experience in business analysis, data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a similar role.
A genuine interest in understanding business operations and improving them through data and analytics.
Practical experience with Power BI, SQL, Snowflake, dbt, and Git.
Hands-on experience in data modelling, including designing and maintaining data models for reporting and analytics.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into clear requirements and practical solutions.
Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders and technical teams, take ownership, and drive work forward.
Experience with agile development practices and digital product development.
Knowledge of Python, airline operations, or another operationally critical environment is considered an advantage.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
Excellent written and spoken English is required; Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.

We offer you an exciting opportunity to work in the fast-changing aviation and international travel industry in a culture that drives and enables professional development and continuous improvement. .

jobs.title: Robotics Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

As a Robotics Mechancial Engineer, you will play a key role in the design and development of our robots. You will be responsible for creating robust and efficient mechanical mechanisms, assemblies, and systems that integrate with advanced robotic technologies. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, bringing together expertise in mechanical, electrical, and software engineering.

The day-to-day

Design and develop mechanisms, systems, and electromechanical assemblies for robotic applications, including structures, actuators, and motion systems.
Collaborate closely with the electrical and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of mechanical designs into complete robotic systems.
Prototype, test, and iterate on mechanical designs to meet performance, cost, and manufacturability requirements.
Analyze project specifications, materials, and manufacturing methods to ensure that designs meet both functional and production objectives.
Use CAD tools (SolidWorks) to create detailed designs, 3D models, and engineering drawings.
Participate in design reviews, contributing innovative solutions and improvements.
Conduct simulations, stress analysis, and FEA to ensure reliability, durability, and safety of the designs.
Provide technical support and troubleshooting during product development and manufacturing processes.
Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in robotics and mechanical design to incorporate cutting-edge technologies into our products.

You should apply if you

Hold a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (Master’s preferred).
Have demonstrated of experience in mechanical design, preferably in robotics or automation.
Are proficiency with CAD software (ideally SolidWorks).
Have a strong understanding of mechanical principles, including statics, dynamics, and material properties.
Have experience with FEA, simulations, and mechanical stress analysis tools.
Have hands-on experience with prototyping and testing.
Are familiar with manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal manufacturing and injection molding.
Have excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and within a team.
Have strong communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
Have experience with robotics, automation, or mechatronics systems is highly desirable.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns
The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world
Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward
In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts
We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

Competitive salary and VSOP options

️ **Title:** Commercial & Strategy Analyst

**Department:** Analytics. Reporting to the Head of Analytics, working closely with our Co-Founder & CEO

**Salary:** £60,000 - £80,000 + equity

.

**Equity:** A very generous EMI share offering.

**Holiday:** 26 days + bank holidays.

**Mission:** Elevate later life for everybody and build the care sector of the future.

**Office Policy:** Hybrid with a minimum of 2 core office days per week.

**Office Location:** London Bridge, London, UK.

  

**The Opportunity:**

Lottie is building the AI operating system for social care. Families find care through our marketplace. Care providers use Found to manage enquiries, occupancy and finances, with Eliza, our AI agent, answering family calls and chats on their behalf.

Lottie is growing fast. Care providers want what we're building, and we're heading into our next stage of growth. We need someone to get under the skin of the numbers, understand what's driving our success, and turn that into the plans, budgets and decisions that shape where we go next.

That's where you come in. You'll be the technical, commercially minded person at our CEO's side - writing the SQL, building the models and bringing the numbers that shape our biggest decisions. No middle man between the founder and the data: you go to the source yourself, work it out from first principles, turn it into a clear recommendation and then help make it happen.

With 2027 set to be Lottie’s most ambitious year yet, you'll own business planning and budgets, support investor relations and future M&A, and partner with teams across Lottie, including our commercial and marketing teams, to help them hit their goals. If you love both the data and the commercial story behind it, this is the role for you!

  

**What does this role involve?**

* **Shape where Lottie goes next:** Work directly with the execs on the biggest calls we make - pricing, where we invest, what we build - and own the analysis that decides them.
* **Sit at the heart of the business:** Partner with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Ops and Finance to uncover what's really driving performance, and help each team act on it.
* **Help build the plan:** Work with leadership on the annual plan, budgets and forecasts - the models we actually use to make decisions.
* **Investor relations:** Own the financial models and be the go-to person for investors on all things numbers.
* **Turn insight into change:** Take a question from analysis all the way to delivery, running it like a PM so the business actually moves.
* **Build, don't inherit:** Use SQL, Python and AI to build the tools and processes a scaling company needs, from first principles.

**What problems will you be solving?**

* **Financial modelling:** Build and maintain the financial models that leadership uses to plan, test scenarios and make decisions
* **The data behind our success:** Why is a new growth channel working so well, and how do we double down on it?
* **Pricing & unit economics:** What drives margin in each product, and where pricing and packaging can lift it.
* **Board-ready numbers:** Models, metrics and reporting that stand up to the scrutiny of investors.
* **M&A:** Identify, evaluate and understand strategic acquisitions that accelerate Lottie growth.
* **Getting to the "why":** Moving from what the numbers say to why they say it, and what we should do about it.

**We think you'll be a great fit if you…**

* **Understand financial statements -** Understand and interpret financial statements, including the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement, to assess business performance, identify trends and inform strategic decisions.
* **You are genuinely technical** - you write your own SQL, work in git, are comfortable in Python and build financial models from scratch.
* **Work deeply with AI** - you use tools like Claude every day to query data, build models and move faster.
* **Are commercially minded and keen to lean into finance** - you understand how a business makes money and want to grow into budgets, forecasts and investor models.
* Think from **first principles** and get quickly to how a business really makes money.
* Can take a messy question, get to the data yourself and **present a clear recommendation** to a founder and leadership team.
* Enjoy working **closely with a founder** - direct, curious and comfortable challenging up.
* Are a **builder, not just a modeller** - you take a topic, run it like a PM and make it happen across the business at startup pace.

*Sound like you but not quite 100%? Apply anyway - we're looking for potential and passion, not a perfect CV match.*

  

**This role isn't for you if you...**

* **Need someone else to pull the data.** Here you write the SQL, build the model and own the answer.
* **Want to hand over a deck and walk away.** We need someone who sees the decision through and makes the change happen.
* Like analysis but shy away from action that comes from it. You'll be expected to make the call and defend it with the CEO and the leadership team.
* **Need a clear playbook and constant direction**. Most of what you'll work on hasn't been done here before.
* **Want to stay in your lane.** This role spans Growth, Product, Ops and Finance, often in the same week.

**Lottie's Interview Process**

* First interview with Lottie's Talent Acquisition Lead - 20 mins (remote)

* Interview with Will Donnelly, Lottie's Co-Founder & CEO - 30 mins (remote)

* Technical interviews - SQL, Python and financial modelling (using AI tools is encouraged)

* Final interview with Will Donnelly in Lottie’s office.

John Crane, a business of Smiths Group, is a global leader in mission-critical flow control solutions for energy and process industries that enable efficient and sustainable operations. Our products include mechanical seals and systems, couplings, bearings, filtration systems, and predictive digital monitoring technologies.

We have a global network of more than 200 sites in over 50 countries and employ more than 6,000 people worldwide. We partner with our customers to help them keep their operations safe, reduce downtime, improve efficiency, and meet the latest environmental standards.

John Crane is part of Smiths Group. For over 170 years, Smiths has been pioneering progress by engineering for a better future. We serve millions of people every year, helping to create a safer, more efficient, productive, and better-connected world across four global markets: energy, security & defence, space & aerospace, and general industrial. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, Smiths employs approximately 16,000 colleagues in over 50 countries.

John Crane is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to crafting an inclusive environment for all employees.

* Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualisations using tools such as Excel, Power BI, and SAP to support business decision-making.
* Assist in pricing reviews by analysing profitability, price realisation, discount levels, and competitive market data.
* Work with Sales, Finance, CRM, and Commercial teams to ensure pricing data is accurate, consistent, and up to date.
* Help identify process improvements and automation opportunities to increase efficiency in pricing and reporting activities.
* Support customer and product performance analysis, providing insights and recommendations to improve revenue and margin outcomes.
* Develop analytical, technical, and commercial skills through structured training while contributing to real business projects and continuous improvement initiatives.

**What We Offer**

* Education: You will be enrolled onto the Level 4 Data Analyst Apprenticeship standard which will be delivered remotely by our training partner QA.
* Learning Opportunities: Gain practical data analysis skills and learn from experts around you.
* Rotations: You will have the opportunity to rotate across different teams to broaden your knowledge and skills
* Professional Development: Develop professional skills such as writing, communication, time management, and teamwork.
* Impactful Work: Contribute to enhancing revenue, delivery performance, efficiency, technical reputation, and customer satisfaction.

**The Individual**

* Have a keen interest in data analysis and a desire to learn
* Committed to learning and working at the same time
* Advanced MS Office skills
* Decision making ability and good influencing / team working skills
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work well in a team.
* Time management and organisational skills

 **Qualifications**

* Level 3 qualification (Apprenticeship/A-levels/BTEC, etc), we also welcome applications from those with a STEM Degree
* OR equivalent work experience (typically two years in a relevant role)
* 5 GCSEs, including English and Maths at Grade 4 (C) or above

Experience with using PowerBi and Excel is preferred, with some knowledge of VBA, SQL and/or Python a plus.

 **Additional Information**

With colleagues stretching across the globe, we are proud of our diversity. To foster inclusivity, we run employee resource groups (ERGs) to provide a safe space for employees to connect and support each other. Our cross-business ERGs include Veterans, Pride Network, Black Employee Network, Women@Work Network, and Neurodiversity.

jobs.description:
**Summary:**

Are you a data whiz who loves solving real-world problems? Do you want to play a critical role in tackling one of the biggest challenges in the water industry?
  
  
We are looking for a Leakage Data Analyst to join our Leakage Data Team in Snodland. The candidate will also be expected to spend 1-2 days a week in the Kent regional office near Detling.
  
  
This is an opportunity to apply your analytical expertise to complex and meaningful work. Leakage reduction is a fundamental part of South East Water’s overall strategy, and this role is integral to providing the analytical information that drives our strategic goals.
  
  
This role would work closely with the Kent regional leakage operations team to help target leakage using all available data. Alongside targeting of leakage, the successful candidate would be expected to perform area specific deep dives and investigations to help improve our overall understanding of the network to ensure more efficient identification of leakage. There will also be an element of regulatory reporting making this a great opportunity to begin a career in the water industry.
  
  
The Leakage Data team is expanding, meaning you’ll work with a wide range of data on exciting projects, including innovative techniques like satellite surveys, drone surveys, and dark fibre. We are dedicated to continuous improvement of our processes to ensure all components of the water balance are as accurate as possible.
  
  
You will need to be proficiency in the use of data manipulation tools. A bonus would be understanding of water networks but this can be learnt within the role. If you are driven by challenging projects and providing high-quality, granular insight, you will find this role both rewarding and crucial to ensuring we remain compliant and meet our team objectives.

**Main responsibilities:**

  

* Lead the regulatory reporting of leakage and the water balance, ensuring timely and accurate completion.
* Work within the Leakage Data Team as we develop a new system and methodology for leakage management and reporting.
* Provide analysis of Zonal and DMA nightline data to explain movements and trend analysis.
* Identify errors, trends, and unusual activity through data analysis.
* Receive, interpret, input, and update technical information to ensure the integrity of recorded information and record databases.
* Continuously improve processes and data to ensure all components of the water balance are as accurate as possible and readily available for timely reporting.
* Evaluate and analyse operational information and understand data integrity difficulties to resolve basic problems.
* Support the development of new systems and insight into leakage operations to enable field teams to work as efficiently as possible.
Other duties may include: Supporting the roll-out of Smart Water Networks and interpreting the resulting data and alarms to reduce leakage and the impact of supply interruptions.  

  

**What you’ll need**

**Skills / Qualifications / Experience:**

  

* Educated to a degree level, including some level of statistical analysis experience (e.g., an undergraduate module in statistics).
* A strong understanding of statistical analytics.
* Proficiency in data manipulation tools.
* An understanding of the component parts of regulatory reported leakage.
* The ability to find ways of solving or pre-empting problems
* A basic level of Structured Query Language (SQL) to efficiently retrieve, manipulate and clean large datasets from operational databases (e.g., asset management systems, SCADA systems) **.**

We know the communities we serve are diverse. We recognise creativity comes from diversity not similarity. * Investigate production issues across application logic, data, scheduled processes, and interfaces. Identify root causes and implement fixes.

**Requirements**  

**Required Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience in PeopleSoft application development and production support, with functional knowledge of at least one module in PeopleSoft HCM, Financials and Supply Chain Management (FSCM), or Campus Solutions.
* Proficiency with PeopleTools, including Application Designer, PeopleCode, and Application Engine.

* Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to business users and collaborate with technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Integration Broker, Component Interfaces, or REST and SOAP web services.
* Experience with PeopleSoft Fluid User Interface, BI Publisher, or PeopleSoft Query.
* Experience with PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM), Change Assistant, or PeopleTools upgrades.

jobs.title: Commercial & Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
**Title:** Commercial & Strategy Analyst

**Department:** Analytics. Reporting to the Head of Analytics, working closely with our Co-Founder & CEO

**Salary:** £60,000 - £80,000 + equity

**Benefits & Culture:** See here.

**Equity:** A very generous EMI share offering.

**Holiday:** 26 days + bank holidays.

**Mission:** Elevate later life for everybody and build the care sector of the future.

**Office Policy:** Hybrid with a minimum of 2 core office days per week.

**Office Location:** London Bridge, London, UK.

**The Opportunity:**

Lottie is building the AI operating system for social care. Families find care through our marketplace. Care providers use Found to manage enquiries, occupancy and finances, with Eliza, our AI agent, answering family calls and chats on their behalf.

Lottie is growing fast. Care providers want what we're building, and we're heading into our next stage of growth. We need someone to get under the skin of the numbers, understand what's driving our success, and turn that into the plans, budgets and decisions that shape where we go next.

That's where you come in. You'll be the technical, commercially minded person at our CEO's side - writing the SQL, building the models and bringing the numbers that shape our biggest decisions. No middle man between the founder and the data: you go to the source yourself, work it out from first principles, turn it into a clear recommendation and then help make it happen.

With 2027 set to be Lottie’s most ambitious year yet, you'll own business planning and budgets, support investor relations and future M&A, and partner with teams across Lottie, including our commercial and marketing teams, to help them hit their goals. If you love both the data and the commercial story behind it, this is the role for you!

**What does this role involve?**

* **Shape where Lottie goes next:** Work directly with the execs on the biggest calls we make - pricing, where we invest, what we build - and own the analysis that decides them.
* **Sit at the heart of the business:** Partner with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Ops and Finance to uncover what's really driving performance, and help each team act on it.
* **Help build the plan:** Work with leadership on the annual plan, budgets and forecasts - the models we actually use to make decisions.
* **Investor relations:** Own the financial models and be the go-to person for investors on all things numbers.
* **Turn insight into change:** Take a question from analysis all the way to delivery, running it like a PM so the business actually moves.
* **Build, don't inherit:** Use SQL, Python and AI to build the tools and processes a scaling company needs, from first principles.

**What problems will you be solving?**

* **Financial modelling:** Build and maintain the financial models that leadership uses to plan, test scenarios and make decisions
* **The data behind our success:** Why is a new growth channel working so well, and how do we double down on it?
* **Pricing & unit economics:** What drives margin in each product, and where pricing and packaging can lift it.
* **Board-ready numbers:** Models, metrics and reporting that stand up to the scrutiny of investors.
* **M&A:** Identify, evaluate and understand strategic acquisitions that accelerate Lottie growth.
* **Getting to the "why":** Moving from what the numbers say to why they say it, and what we should do about it.

**We think you'll be a great fit if you…**

* **Understand financial statements -** Understand and interpret financial statements, including the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement, to assess business performance, identify trends and inform strategic decisions.
* **You are genuinely technical** - you write your own SQL, work in git, are comfortable in Python and build financial models from scratch.
* **Work deeply with AI** - you use tools like Claude every day to query data, build models and move faster.
* **Are commercially minded and keen to lean into finance** - you understand how a business makes money and want to grow into budgets, forecasts and investor models.
* Think from **first principles** and get quickly to how a business really makes money.
* Can take a messy question, get to the data yourself and **present a clear recommendation** to a founder and leadership team.
* Enjoy working **closely with a founder** - direct, curious and comfortable challenging up.
* Are a **builder, not just a modeller** - you take a topic, run it like a PM and make it happen across the business at startup pace.

*Sound like you but not quite 100%? Apply anyway - we're looking for potential and passion, not a perfect CV match.*

**This role isn't for you if you...**

* **Need someone else to pull the data.** Here you write the SQL, build the model and own the answer.
* **Want to hand over a deck and walk away.** We need someone who sees the decision through and makes the change happen.
* Like analysis but shy away from action that comes from it. You'll be expected to make the call and defend it with the CEO and the leadership team.
* **Need a clear playbook and constant direction**. Most of what you'll work on hasn't been done here before.
* **Want to stay in your lane.** This role spans Growth, Product, Ops and Finance, often in the same week.

**Lottie's Interview Process**

* First interview with Lottie's Talent Acquisition Lead - 20 mins (remote)
* Interview with Will Donnelly, Lottie's Co-Founder & CEO - 30 mins (remote)
* Technical interviews - SQL, Python and financial modelling (using AI tools is encouraged)
* Final interview with Will Donnelly in Lottie’s office.

**Candidate Experience:**

* **Pre-Screen & First Interview:** You'll receive an email notification, but no specific feedback will be provided at this stage.
* **Technical Interviews:** If you are not successful after the technical stage, you'll receive constructive feedback via email and be offered a debrief call with our Talent Lead.
* **Final Interview:** For fin

**Why FT Partners?**

jobs.title: BloombergNEF Europe Regional Research Analyst
jobs.description:
BloombergNEF (BNEF) is seeking an analyst to join our Europe research team in London. The role will focus on major themes shaping Europe’s energy transition across sectors and technologies, alongside ownership of research on selected priority markets.

BNEF is a strategic research provider covering global commodity markets and the transformative forces reshaping energy systems and infrastructure. Our experts assess the technological, economic and policy drivers that underpin the transition to a cleaner, more resilient energy economy. We help senior leaders in corporate strategy, finance, policy and commodity trading navigate change and generate opportunities.

  
  

**BNEF Team Ethos**

  
  

To succeed at BNEF we need people who can work in an independent manner and show initiative to develop their own viewpoints, yet be collaborative with colleagues. We don't rely on the status quo, we look for innovative yet pragmatic thinking that turns big ideas into real insights and impact. We need teams that are both dynamic and structured to generate the unique perspectives our clients really value. Our teams are diverse, creative, focused, and fun!

  
  

**Our Team**

  
  

You will be based in our London office, working as part of BloombergNEF’s Europe research team. The Europe team works across markets and technologies, moving quickly to answer the questions that matter most to our clients, and working closely with teams that specialize in a particular sector, technology or commodity. Our research combines regional analysis with detailed country-level work across power markets, clean energy technologies, policy, investment and the economics of the transition.

Our data-driven research helps clients decide where to invest or expand, understand how policy and market changes affect project economics, identify emerging opportunities and assess what could change their outlook.

  
  

**The Role**

  
  

You will produce original research on Europe’s energy transition, covering major regional themes and selected priority markets.

The role combines independent research, responsibility for specific markets and cross-team collaboration. You will be expected to get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar topics, form a clear view from complex or fast-moving information and turn that into rigorous analysis. Your work will range from short, timely research pieces to datasets, models and longer-term outlooks.

Data and technology are increasingly central to how we work. You will be expected to work confidently with large and complex datasets and use coding, automation and generative AI to improve research workflows and develop new analytical approaches.

From early in your career, we will trust you to become a go-to expert within BNEF and with our clients for the markets and topics you cover. You will regularly brief senior decision-makers and policymakers, answer their questions and explain and defend your conclusions. You will also represent BNEF at events and build a deep industry network.

  
  

**We Will Trust You To**

  
  

* Own BNEF’s coverage of selected priority European markets from day one, staying on top of developments and identifying the questions that matter
* Lead independent research projects from initial idea and data sourcing through analysis and publication
* Build and maintain datasets, models and analytical tools to produce rigorous research that supports decision-making
* Use coding, automation and AI to improve workflows and develop new analytical approaches
* Communicate your conclusions clearly to clients and colleagues, and represent BNEF externally as your expertise develops
  

  

**You'll Need To Have**

  
  

* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in science, technology, engineering, mathematics, economics, finance, or another relevant quantitative discipline
* A strong interest in Europe’s energy transition and the forces that shape it
* Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership and get things done
* Excellent quantitative and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities and confidence working with large and complex datasets
* Strong written communication and data visualization skills, with excellent attention to detail
* The ability to think critically, evaluate complex information and develop an independent view
* Demonstrated presentation and verbal communication skills, with the ability to quickly understand, distill and explain complex topics to specialist and non-specialist audiences
  

  

**We’d Love To See**

  
  

* Experience working in or analyzing power markets, energy policy, clean energy technologies or other relevant parts of the energy sector
* Experience building quantitative models, data pipelines or analytical tools from complex datasets
* Demonstrated ability to use generative AI, python and SQL to build and improve analytical or research workflows
* Fluency or strong working proficiency in at least one European language in addition to English; German language skills would be particularly valuable

If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

We partner with life sciences companies around the world to generate evidence to demonstrate the value of their product, translate the science and data into compelling product narratives, and enable commercial decisions that position these products for success in the market. We do this through strategic and complimentary areas of focus: Asset Optimization and Commercialization, Value Access and Outcomes, Medical Strategy and Communications, and Real-World Evidence.

Responsibilities / Position overview:

The Project Finance Analyst supports the financial management and performance of client projects within an assigned Practice. The role works closely with Finance Managers, Project Managers, Delivery teams and Business Operations to maintain accurate project financial information, support forecasting and reporting, identify financial risks and ensure consistent execution of project finance processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Financial Management**

* Support project financial management, including EAC (monthly project financial status), revenue, margin, backlog, utilization and project profitability.
* Maintain accurate project financial data, forecasts and supporting schedules.
* Monitor project performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and emerging risks.
* Support analysis of project overruns, overservicing, margin leakage and other performance issues.
* Assist Finance Managers with project health reviews and financial performance improvement initiatives.

**2. Reporting & Financial Analysis**

* Prepare recurring project financial reports, reconciliations and variance analysis.
* Support revenue, margin and utilization forecasting through accurate project-level inputs.
* Analyze changes in project financial performance and provide clear supporting explanations.
* Prepare financial analysis to support portfolio reviews, staffing decisions and business priorities.
* Identify data inconsistencies and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.

**3. Business Partnership**

* Work with Finance Managers, Project Managers, Delivery teams and Business Operations to support effective project financial management.
* Provide timely financial information and analysis to support project decisions.
* Follow up on outstanding project financial inputs, issues and corrective actions.
* Develop an understanding of project economics, delivery performance and commercial drivers.

**4. Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Support month-end close readiness, project reconciliations and financial controls.
* Maintain accurate financial information across NetSuite, Kantata and reporting systems.
* Ensure consistent application of enterprise Finance standards, processes and reporting requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve data quality, simplify reporting and automate recurring activities.
* Support Project Velocity initiatives, including EAC, Project Health, utilization and margin improvement.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics or related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in finance, accounting, FP&A or a related analytical role.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Excel and ability to work with financial and operational data.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet recurring deadlines.
* Willingness to develop proficiency in ERP, project management and reporting tools.
* Professional services or other project-based industry experience preferred but not required.

Benefits:

* Competitive salary plus annual bonus scheme
* Private health insurance plus enhanced dental and optical cover

* Enhanced maternity and paternity pay for employees with 2+ years of service

jobs.title: Data Scientist, AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Own the detection models and the measurement science that find fraudulent and compromised AWS accounts in real time. Join a team of scientists and engineers whose analysis decides how fraud is detected and stopped, and how fast.  
The AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention organization keeps AWS a safe place to build for millions of customers. Our team owns the science behind fraud and compromise detection on AWS. Account compromise is the case where a legitimate customer's credentials are stolen or exposed and an attacker uses the account to run unauthorized workloads. Fraud is the case where an account exists to consume resources with no intent to pay. Most accounts our models score belong to legitimate customers, so every decision has to stop fraud while leaving their work undisturbed. As a Data Scientist you will own detection models end to end, from the first look at an emerging pattern through feature design, training, shadow evaluation, production launch and the weekly performance review. You will define how we measure ourselves: precision by outcome, time to detect, runtime of unauthorized resources, and the cost a model prevented.  

* Own models that detect and block fraudulent activity in real time, protecting customers and AWS.
* Turn a pattern spotted in a handful of accounts into a model that screens millions.
* Define the metrics your models and systems are measured by and discuss them in weekly and monthly business reviews.
* End-to-end ownership, from the first signal to the enforcement action and the cleanup after it.

  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own detection models and rules end to end: frame the problem with partners, source and engineer features from large-scale activity, sign-in and usage data, train and validate, run shadow evaluations, launch, and monitor performance after launch.
* Investigate new fraud and compromise patterns as they emerge, quantify their scale and design the detection response, from a fast rule to a trained model, with the trade-off between speed and precision stated.
* Define and audit the metrics that measure our systems: outcome-based precision and recall, time to detect, runtime of unauthorized resources, prevented cost. Own the analysis behind weekly and monthly business reviews.
* Evaluate agentic and LLM-based systems: build labeled evaluation sets, measure error rates in both directions, and set the thresholds under which automation is allowed to act.
* Extend detection to new AWS services as they launch, including AI services where spend accrues in minutes.
* Write clear technical documents for scientists and for non-technical partners in operations, engineering and leadership, and present them in science reviews.
* Mentor junior scientists and analysts on method, and help interview for the team.

  
A day in the life  
You begin with the performance review of the models you own: what they caught, what was later overturned, and what slipped past every layer. You pull the misses, find that three share a pattern you have not seen before, size it in the data, write a shadow-mode rule, and put a one-page analysis in front of the team with the precision you expect and the cost of waiting for a full model. In the team's planning session for the next quarter, that analysis becomes a proposal for a new model and you make the case for its place on the roadmap against the other layers of the detection stack. You also audit the cases your agentic system resolved on its own and adjust its evaluation set and thresholds. You use AI coding assistants daily, for SQL, Python and documentation, and you check their work. Your stakeholders are the fraud engineering teams that power your models, the teams that act on their decisions, the AWS service teams whose customers we protect, and the leadership that reads your numbers every week.  
  
About the team  
We are a team of scientists, analysts, software and data engineers and a program manager, with close partners across AWS Fraud Prevention worldwide. We own the science behind fraud and compromise detection on AWS, from signal and detection through decision, enforcement, cleanup and reinstatement. We follow a layered detection strategy with online and offline machine learning models and agentic investigation systems. Our models also run in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, where they must work under EU data-residency constraints.  
We invest in the growth of every team member through mentorship, careful code and document reviews, and projects sized to stretch you. We celebrate promotions, and new members ship their first project within their first quarter.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science
* Experience with data scripting languages (e.g. SQL, Python, R etc.) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, or Matlab)
* Experience with statistical modeling / machine learning
* Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results
* This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience with one of the following areas: machine learning technologies, Reinforcement Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP) or related applications
* Experience in fraud, risk, security or another adversarial domain where the data shifts in response to your models.
* Experience deploying machine learning models in cloud infrastructure and monitoring them after launch, including retraining.
* Experience with AWS

jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About the role**

As an Operations Analyst within Group Operations, you will play an important role in shaping and optimizing Instabee's first- and middle-mile transport network. You will work with strategy, network design and data analysis to improve the efficiency, quality and reliability of our transport routes between merchant warehouses and Instabee terminals across our five markets: Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Norway and the Netherlands.

Working closely with our local Market teams, you will identify improvement opportunities, analyze network performance and ensure that the right data, insights and tools are available to support well-informed operational decisions. You will also collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to develop scalable solutions that improve our transport operations and create a great experience for our merchants.

You will be part of the First and Middle Mile team within Group Operations, reporting to the First and Middle Mile Manager, who will support your onboarding, learning and professional development.

### **What you’ll do**

In this role, you will:

* Analyze and design first- and middle-mile transport networks to identify opportunities for improved efficiency, quality and cost performance.
* Work closely with local Market teams to understand operational needs, evaluate current performance and drive improvements across our markets.
* Develop and maintain the data landscape for first- and middle-mile operations, integrating data from different tools and systems to create valuable insights.
* Monitor operational performance and ensure high-quality and reliable transport operations.
* Collaborate with colleagues across Tech, Commercial and Integration to ensure that tools and solutions are developed in line with operational needs and provide a great merchant experience.
* Build dashboards and analytical tools to support data-driven decision-making and enable best-practice sharing across markets.

### **What we're looking for**

We believe you are a curious and analytical person who enjoys solving complex problems and understanding how different parts of a system connect. You combine a strategic mindset with a structured and hands-on approach, and are motivated by turning data and insights into tangible improvements.

We also believe you have:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex challenges and strategic goals into actionable improvements.
* A structured and data-driven approach, with great attention to detail and an ability to prioritize initiatives based on their potential impact.
* An interest in data analysis and experience working with tools such as SQL and Excel/Google Sheets. Experience with Tableau is a plus.
* The ability to evaluate complex, interconnected systems and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, allowing you to build relationships and work effectively with stakeholders across different teams and markets.
* A genuine curiosity and interest in logistics, transport and operational development.

### **What you’ll get**

We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!  
  
Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:

* Brand-New Office — More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.
* Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
* A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
* Hybrid setup and flexible working hours.

### **Get to know us**

In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.

We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.

*This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.*

Every day, millions of people rely on safe, clean drinking water. This apprenticeship offers the opportunity to start or develop a practical career in the water industry while gaining valuable experience and an industry-recognised qualification.

As a Network Analyst at Veriflo, you will play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of client projects. Drawing on your experience in project support or a similar role, you will be responsible for preparing job packs, coordinating and scheduling activities, and working closely with field-based, operational and technical teams to ensure work is delivered efficiently and effectively.

You will regularly engage with colleagues, clients and key stakeholders, developing a strong understanding of clean water networks. Using GIS mapping tools, you will compile accurate asset investigation packs to support operational activities and project delivery.

Part of the Celnor Group

Celnor Group is a UK-based environmental services group operating across the Testing, Inspection, Certification and Compliance (TICC) landscape. With a growing portfolio of specialist businesses, Celnor provides essential services that protect people, property and the environment.

What you will do
You will need a strong understanding of the M25 and surrounding areas, you will use GIS mapping, network schematics and Street View to prepare accurate and detailed work packs for field investigations.
Act as the main point of contact for Field Teams, responding to queries and working closely with technical and operational leads to prioritise workloads and ensure smooth project delivery
Prepare and raise Stage 1 and Stage 2 permits to work, with guidance from Network Engineers and Project Managers.
Coordinate site access and traffic management arrangements, liaising with internal teams, local authorities, clients and external stakeholders.
Plan and schedule field activities, ensuring resources are allocated effectively based on technician locations, availability and project requirements.
Monitor project progress, maintaining accurate documentation, audits, shut packs and operational records.
Identify and resolve survey-related issues, ensuring company systems and project trackers are kept accurate and up to date.

Who you are
A minimum of 2 years’ experience in a project support, coordination or similar role, with an understanding of the full project lifecycle.
Confident using Microsoft Office 365, including Word, Outlook, PowerPoint and Teams, as well as virtual meeting platforms such as Zoom.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage professionally and effectively with colleagues, clients and stakeholders.
Strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to prepare, coordinate and communicate clear, detailed work plans, with a good understanding of project logistics and operational requirements.
Comfortable managing multiple projects, balancing competing priorities and working effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Veriflo?

Our people’s experience has earned Veriflo Great Place To Work® Certification and recognition on the 2026 UK’s Best Workplaces for Development™ list, celebrating organisations that create outstanding opportunities for employees to learn, grow and thrive.

If you are ready to learn, gain hands-on experience and build a long-term career in the water industry, we would love to hear from you. Every apprentice is expected to work towards and successfully achieve the Level 3 Apprenticeship in Water Distribution, and this is your opportunity to develop alongside a supportive team.

Benefits
Health & Lifestyle Rewards Scheme with Benenden Health, including 24/7 GP access, private healthcare options, and discounts at over 3,500 retailers.
Enhanced annual leave, with an additional day awarded for each year of service after five consecutive years, capped at 30 days (excluding bank holidays).
Employer pension contribution set at 1% above the national minimum under auto-enrolment.
Flexible hybrid working model (3:2 office/site to home) following successful completion of probation.
Support and funding for relevant professional qualifications and memberships, in line with company training and professional development policies.
Two companywide events each year, including a summer team-building event and a Christmas party.
Annual appraisal process with a companywide salary review.
Competitive refer-a-friend reward scheme.

.

Important information

Celnor Group and its businesses manage recruitment directly. We do not require agency support for this role and will only engage with recruitment partners from our preferred supplier list where necessary.

We may use technology, including AI-enabled tools, to support parts of the recruitment process. AI is not used for candidate screening, scoring or hiring decisions. All hiring decisions are made by people, for people. Our recruitment systems are ISO 42001 accredited, reflecting our commitment to ethical, transparent and responsible use of technology.

jobs.description:
Programme start date: September 2027

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application.

Our award-winning graduate programme provides the ideal springboard for an exciting and meaningful career in global financial markets.

As a graduate, you will join the FTSE Russell Division. The division is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where instant reaction and long-term vision are equally important.

Our FTSE Russell division helps investors make better-informed decisions for indices and benchmarking solutions. FTSE Russell provides category-defining indices across asset classes and investment objectives to create new possibilities for the global investment community.

To be eligible, you must be a graduate who has completed your studies in 2026 or a final year undergraduate or Master’s student and have completed all the requirements of your course before summer 2027.

Highlights of the Graduate Programme

Progress through a 12-month development journey aiming to build foundational skills that are key for your future success
Build your foundational knowledge of LSEG, Financial Markets, and the business during your global induction
Divisional-led inductions to immerse graduates into the business through team-led overviews and introductions
Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals
Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills
Access opportunities to earn industry-recognized qualifications, including 5 study days during the programme
Connect with the global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities

Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to FTSE Russell, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework.

This is a great opportunity for students studying a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics subject
or Finance, Economics with a strong inclination towards FinTech/Technology to apply their skills to a Business-related role. During the recruitment process, we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align with the needs of the business to place you in your first rotation.

What We Are Looking For

We are passionate about recruiting people who want to understand the full breadth of our organisation, how it fits together, how it functions – and are interested in playing a part of our development, as it grows and diversifies.
You should have a demonstrable interest in financial markets, which you’ve built through your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.
A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions.
Individuals who are able to connect the dots and think strategically.
The environment we work in is fast-paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands.
People who can collaborate with others, using their strong communication skills in the process.
Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the UK without restrictions for the duration of the graduate programme and join us on a permanent basis.

You will stand out to us if you can demonstrate and recognise that what you achieve is equally important as how you achieve it.

Application close: 28 November.
We consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend you apply early.

Recruitment Process

The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume.
The next stage of the application process is an untimed Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG.
The second stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style.
The final stage is a half-day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make
one application. If you make more than one application, we will review your first application only.

Please note, all our assessment centres are held virtually.

Ability to interact effectively with diverse internal and external stakeholders through strong written and verbal English communication.

jobs.title: Privacy Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
Who we are:

At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

About The Role

We're looking for a hands-on, technically driven Privacy Systems Analyst to own Rover's privacy technology platform stack. You'll be the technical operator behind our privacy compliance program: configuring, integrating, troubleshooting, and maintaining our privacy management platform and the systems connected to it.

You'll partner closely with the GRC team, who own the program-level requirements, and make sure what compliance defines, the platform reliably delivers. We're especially looking for someone with a strong instinct for automating manual work, including with AI tooling, and the technical depth to keep the privacy stack performing at scale.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

What You'll Do:

Own the privacy platform: configure and maintain workflows, assessments, consent management, DSAR automation, and reporting. Be the go-to person when something isn't working
Coordinate consent and marketing preferences: support opt-in/opt-out workflows with Marketing, Legal, and Engineering; ensure preference signals are captured, synced, and enforced correctly downstream; troubleshoot gaps between what's configured and what's actually enforced
Manage integrations and APIs: own the API surface connecting the privacy platform to other Rover systems, including authentication, error handling, and monitoring
Handle DSARs end to end: ensure connectors fire correctly, monitor success rates, and resolve errors that block fulfillment
Keep RoPA and Data Map accurate: maintain connectors, validate data inventory, and onboard new sources
Lead new integrations: act as technical lead on integration projects, from design through go-live
Support incident response: partner with Cybersecurity on privacy/security incidents, owning platform-level triage and technical evidence collection
Build AI-driven automation: identify manual, repetitive work (DSAR intake, RoPA upkeep, documentation, vendor tickets) and build AI-assisted workflows to reduce it, always with human review for compliance-sensitive output
Document and mentor: keep configurations, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides current; support more junior team members
Own the vendor relationship: raise and manage technical escalations with evidence, and engage vendor professional services only when the work genuinely exceeds in-house capability

What You'll Need:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
2-5 years administering SaaS platforms, with experience leading moderately complex projects
Hands-on experience with an enterprise privacy management platform (consent management, DSAR automation, data discovery)
Working knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth/API keys, webhooks, and integration troubleshooting
Understanding of SaaS architecture: environments, sandbox-to-production, change management
Strong independent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
Clear communication, especially with non-technical stakeholders
Comfortable working autonomously and knowing when to escalate
Practical, hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to automate workflows, draft documentation, or accelerate troubleshooting

Nice to Have:

Vendor certifications (OneTrust, Ketch, DataGrail, TrustArc, or similar)
Cloud fundamentals certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP)
GDPR/CCPA or global privacy regulation awareness
Scripting experience (Python, JavaScript)
IAM/SSO knowledge
Experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) or calling LLM APIs directly
Awareness of AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001)

Benefits of Working at Rover.com:

Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout
Pension plan
Private medical insurance
25 days PTO
Meal allowance and flexible compensation plan (transport and nursery)
Gym membership
€450 to cover the costs associated with the adoption of a pet
Annual €150 wellness reimbursement
Flexible work hours, sometimes you'll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we're pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
Regular team activities, events, game nights, and more
Dog-friendly office

Compensation:

In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €38,946 - €47,207. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees
The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process

We’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, and we work to ensure everyone contributes to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, protected veteran status, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
